title: Chicken and Roasted Vegetable Meal Prep

lines.t: 1 sweet potato, cut into 1/2 inch cubes

lines.food: Chicken, broilers or fryers, breast, meat only, cooked, roasted

steps: Heat the oven to 425°F (220°C). Toss the sweet potato with a little oil, salt, pepper and the curry powder and spread on a tray.
Toss the sprouts with 1 tsp oil, the lemon juice, garlic, salt and pepper on a second tray.
Roast both 30 minutes, turning halfway; add the asparagus to the sprouts tray for the last 15 minutes with a drizzle of oil.
Divide the vegetables and sliced chicken into 4 containers. Reheat 2 minutes.

title: Chinese Chicken Meal Prep Bowl

lines.food: Chicken, broilers or fryers, breast, meat only, cooked, roasted
Onions, spring or scallions (includes tops and bulb), raw

steps: Steam the broccoli and pepper 4 to 5 minutes until just tender.
Divide the rice, vegetables and sliced chicken into 4 containers and top with sesame seeds and green onion.
Chill; reheat 2 minutes.

title: Zucchini Noodle Chicken Bowl

lines.food: Chicken, broilers or fryers, breast, meat only, cooked, roasted
Squash, summer, zucchini, includes skin, raw

steps: Warm the oil and cook the garlic 1 minute.
Add the zucchini noodles and cook until just tender; pour off any liquid and season with the Italian seasoning, salt and pepper.
Divide into 4 containers and top with the sauce and sliced chicken. Reheat 2 minutes.

title: Turkey Lettuce Wraps with Hoisin

lines.food: Onions, spring or scallions (includes tops and bulb), raw

steps: Cook the turkey with both oils, the garlic and ginger until done; drain any fat.
Mix the hoisin, soy sauce, vinegar and chili paste, pour over and toss.
Pack with green onion, with the lettuce leaves kept separate. Reheat the turkey 2 minutes and spoon into the leaves.

title: Turkey Taco Bowl

lines.food: Beans, black, mature seeds, canned, low sodium
Corn, sweet, yellow, canned, whole kernel, drained solids

steps: Cook the turkey, onion, pepper and jalapeño in the oil until the turkey is done; drain any fat.
Stir in the spices with a splash of water.
Divide into 4 containers with the beans and corn. Keep the red onion and avocado separate and add after reheating.

title: Korean Turkey and Quinoa Bowl

lines.food: Onions, spring or scallions (includes tops and bulb), raw

steps: Simmer the quinoa in 2 cups water, covered, 15 minutes; fluff.
Cook the garlic and ginger in the oil for a minute, then brown the turkey and drain.
Mix the sugar, half the soy sauce, sesame oil and pepper flakes, add to the turkey and cook 3 to 5 minutes.
Wilt the bok choy in the same pan with the rest of the soy sauce. Divide everything into 4 bowls with green onion and sesame seeds.

title: Turkey Sloppy Joes on Sweet Potato Toast

lines.food: Tomato products, canned, paste, without salt added

steps: Cook the onion, garlic, pepper and turkey in the oil until done; drain and season.
Stir in the tomato sauce, barbecue sauce, Worcestershire, chili powder, tomato paste and hot sauce and simmer 5 minutes.
Cut the sweet potato into thin lengthwise slices and toast them on high until soft (these are the buns).
Pack the sloppy joe mix with the sweet potato slices and green beans. Reheat 2 minutes.

title: Mexican Breakfast Bowl

lines.food: Beans, black, mature seeds, canned, low sodium

steps: Cook the sweet potato in the oil until soft, then toss with the cumin and chili powder.
Scramble the eggs with salt and pepper.
Divide the potato, eggs, beans and avocado into 4 containers. Reheat 1 to 2 minutes.

title: Spinach, Mushroom and Egg Bowl

lines.food: Tomatoes, red, ripe, raw, year round average

steps: Cook the mushrooms and garlic in the oil 1 to 2 minutes, then add the spinach and tomatoes until wilted. Divide into 4 containers with the avocado.
Bring the eggs to a boil in water, take off the heat, cover 9 minutes, then cool. Add one (in its shell) to each container.
Take the egg out before reheating the vegetables 1 to 2 minutes.

title: Savory Bacon and Cheddar Oatmeal

lines.food: Pork, cured, bacon, pre-sliced, cooked, pan-fried
Cereals, oats, regular and quick, not fortified, dry
Milk, lowfat, fluid, 1% milkfat, with added vitamin A and vitamin D

steps: Crisp the bacon in a pot and set aside.
Simmer the oats in the milk 8 to 10 minutes until thick; season, then stir in the bacon and cheese until melted.
Divide into 4 containers, sprinkle with chives and top each with a fried egg (or fry the egg when you eat it).

title: Coconut Chocolate Energy Bites with Yogurt

lines.food: Cereals, oats, regular and quick, not fortified, dry
Nuts, coconut meat, dried (desiccated), not sweetened
Peanut butter, smooth style, without salt
Skyr Icelandic style strained yogurt < 10 % fat in dry matter

steps: Mix the oats, coconut, peanut butter, chocolate chips, honey and vanilla, roll into balls and freeze 5 to 10 minutes on parchment.
Pack the bites with the strawberries and a yogurt in 3 containers and chill.

title: Berry Apple Overnight Oats

lines.food: Cereals, oats, regular and quick, not fortified, dry
Beverages, almond milk, unsweetened, shelf stable
Nuts, almond butter, plain, without salt added

steps: Mix everything except the almond butter in a bowl; it should be loose, since the chia soaks up liquid.
Spoon into 3 jars, top each with a spoon of almond butter, seal and chill a few hours or overnight.

title: Minestrone with Beans and Lentils

lines.food: Beans, kidney, red, mature seeds, canned, drained solids
Beans, great northern, mature seeds, canned
Tomatoes, red, ripe, canned, packed in tomato juice

steps: Soften the onion, garlic, leek, celery and carrots in the oil 10 minutes.
Add the lentils, tomatoes, broth, a bay leaf and a sprig of rosemary; simmer 25 minutes until the lentils are soft.
Stir in the beans, kale and spinach for 5 minutes and season.

title: Lentil Bolognese

lines.food: Tomatoes, red, ripe, canned, packed in tomato juice
Tomato products, canned, paste, without salt added
Lentils, mature seeds, cooked, boiled, without salt

steps: Soften the onion and garlic in the oil on low heat.
Pulse the carrot, sweet potato, celery, leek and pepper in a food processor, add with the mushrooms and cook until soft.
Add the tomatoes, tomato paste, wine, lentils and a bay leaf; simmer gently about an hour.
Season and serve with the pasta (or zucchini noodles). Keeps 5 days.

title: Moroccan Chicken Tagine with Couscous

lines.food: Chicken, broilers or fryers, dark meat, thigh, meat only, raw
Tomatoes, red, ripe, canned, packed in tomato juice
Chickpeas (garbanzo beans, bengal gram), mature seeds, canned, drained, rinsed in tap water

steps: Rub the chicken with the oil, ginger, cinnamon, paprika and lemon zest and marinate if you have time.
Brown the chicken, add the onions and garlic and soften.
Add the broth, tomatoes, raisins, honey, lentils, harissa, a cinnamon stick and star anise; simmer 40 minutes. Stir in the chickpeas for the last 10.
Pour boiling stock over the couscous, cover 5 minutes, fluff with lemon and parsley. Serve with almonds and cilantro.

title: Sweet Potato Dahl with Chickpea Pancakes

lines.food: Tomatoes, red, ripe, raw, year round average

steps: Cook the onion, garlic, ginger and spices in the oil on low for 10 minutes.
Add the sweet potato and carrots for 5 minutes, then the lentils and stock. Simmer about 30 minutes until soft; stir in the tomatoes for the last 5.
Whisk the chickpea flour, egg and water into a smooth batter and fry thin pancakes in a little oil.
Serve the dahl with the pancakes, cilantro and a spoon of yogurt.

title: Orange Glazed Salmon with Quinoa and Greens
steps: Mix the orange juice, tamari and maple syrup and marinate the salmon (up to a day).
Cook the quinoa.
Roast the salmon on parchment at 350°F (180°C) about 10 minutes. Meanwhile boil the greens 2 to 3 minutes and toss with the oil.
Reduce the leftover marinade in a pan to a glaze and spoon it over the salmon.

title: Roasted Veg Pasta Bake

lines.food: Tomatoes, red, ripe, canned, packed in tomato juice

steps: Cook the pasta until just al dente.
Blend the roasted vegetables with the tomatoes, honey and basil into a sauce.
Mix the pasta, sauce and most of the cheese, put in a baking dish, top with the rest and bake uncovered 20 minutes in a hot oven.

title: Thai Red Pepper Prawn Curry

lines.food: Peppers, sweet, red, canned, solids and liquids
Tomato products, canned, paste, without salt added
Nuts, coconut milk, canned (liquid expressed from grated meat and water)

steps: Blend the peeled roasted peppers with the lemongrass, tomato paste, cilantro, chili, garlic, ginger, lime leaves, soy sauce, fish sauce and both oils into a paste.
Cook the rice.
Warm the paste in a pan, add the coconut milk and simmer, then add the prawns and snap peas for 3 to 4 minutes until the prawns are pink.
Stir in the spinach and lime juice and serve over rice with the cashews.

title: Roasted Pepper and Turmeric Hummus with Veg Sticks

lines.food: Chickpeas (garbanzo beans, bengal gram), mature seeds, canned, drained, rinsed in tap water
Seeds, sesame butter, tahini, from roasted and toasted kernels (most common type)

steps: Roast the pepper and carrot until soft; peel and seed the pepper.
Blend with the chickpeas, tahini, garlic, lemon, turmeric and oil until smooth; season.
Keep carrot and celery sticks in a jar of water in the fridge for dipping.

title: Root Vegetable and Feta Frittata
steps: Toss the vegetables with half the oil, the tamari and honey and roast at 350°F (180°C) about 45 minutes.
Beat the eggs with salt and pepper and pour into an oiled ovenproof pan.
Add about 200 g of the vegetables and the feta and bake 15 to 20 minutes until firm. Cut into 4.

title: Moroccan Spiced Quinoa
steps: Sizzle the spices in the oil, then soften the onion and celery.
Add the quinoa and stock, cover and cook gently 10 to 12 minutes until absorbed.
Stir in the raisins and let it steam a few minutes off the heat. Top with toasted chopped pistachios and cilantro.

title: Herby Lentil Salad
steps: Simmer the lentils (soaked if you have time) about 25 minutes until tender; cool.
Toss with everything else and season. Eat cold, at room temperature or warm.

title: Spinach Tomato Egg Muffins

lines.food: Tomatoes, red, ripe, raw, year round average

steps: Heat the oven to 350°F (175°C) and oil a 12-cup muffin tin.
Whisk the eggs with the basil, salt and pepper and fill each cup halfway.
Divide the onion, garlic, spinach, tomato and cheese between the cups.
Bake 15 to 20 minutes until set. Keeps in the fridge or freezer; reheat to serve.

title: Black Bean Breakfast Burritos

lines.food: Beans, black, mature seeds, canned, low sodium

steps: Cook the onion, pepper, jalapeño, beans and chili powder in the oil 3 to 5 minutes and set aside.
Scramble the eggs on medium-low, then sprinkle with the cheese and season.
Divide the eggs and beans between the tortillas and roll up.
Top with cilantro, yogurt and lime when you eat them (after reheating if made ahead).

title: Greek Yogurt Berry Oat Jar

lines.food: Cereals, oats, regular and quick, not fortified, dry

steps: Stir the honey and cinnamon into the yogurt in a jar.
Layer the oats and berries on top; eat now or chill overnight so the oats soften.
Add the walnuts just before eating.

title: Almond Butter Banana Quesadilla

lines.food: Nuts, almond butter, plain, without salt added

steps: Warm the tortillas in a pan and spread both with almond butter.
Lay the banana on one, drizzle with honey and close with the other.
Toast in the pan about 2 minutes a side until golden, then cut into quarters.

title: Chocolate Peanut Butter Date Bites

lines.food: Cereals, oats, regular and quick, not fortified, dry
Peanut butter, smooth style, without salt
Nuts, coconut meat, dried (desiccated), not sweetened

steps: Soak dry dates in warm water 10 minutes, then blend to a paste.
Pulse in the oats and coconut.
Mash the banana and mix in the date mixture, chia, cocoa, honey and peanut butter.
Roll into balls and keep in the fridge up to a week.

title: Pistachio Pomegranate Oat Bars

lines.food: Cereals, oats, regular and quick, not fortified, dry
Peanut butter, smooth style, without salt

steps: Mix everything in a large bowl (dried cranberries work if you can't find pomegranate).
Press firmly into a parchment-lined 8x8 pan.
Chill 30 to 60 minutes until firm, then cut into 12 bars and wrap.

title: Tart Cherry Berry Recovery Smoothie
steps: Blend everything until smooth, adding water if it's too thick.

title: Creamy Dill Chicken Salad

lines.food: Chicken, broilers or fryers, breast, meat only, cooked, roasted

steps: Grate the cucumber and squeeze out the water in a paper towel.
Mix it with the chicken, yogurt, herbs, garlic, lemon and vinegar; season.
Eat on salad, in a sandwich or with crackers.

title: Pesto Tomato Mozzarella Chicken

lines.food: Chicken, broiler or fryers, breast, skinless, boneless, meat only, raw
Tomatoes, red, ripe, raw, year round average

steps: Heat the oven to 375°F (190°C) and oil a baking dish.
Spread the chicken with pesto and layer the tomato and mozzarella on top.
Bake 25 to 30 minutes until the chicken reaches 165°F (74°C).

title: Quinoa and Tofu Stuffed Peppers

lines.food: Tofu, raw, firm, prepared with calcium sulfate

steps: Cook the quinoa in 2 cups water, covered, 15 to 20 minutes. Heat the oven to 375°F (190°C). Cut the tops off the peppers and seed them.
Soften the carrots, celery, mushrooms, onion and garlic in the oil 3 to 5 minutes, then cook the tofu 6 to 8 minutes.
Mix the quinoa, tofu and vegetables with the oregano, salt and pepper and stuff the peppers. Top with feta.
Stand them in a dish with 1 cup water, cover with oiled foil and bake 45 to 60 minutes until soft.

title: Baked Eggs with Smoked Mackerel and Spinach
source: High Performance Recipe Book (Elysium Health & Fitness)
steps: Heat the oven to 400°F (200°C). Wilt the spinach with boiling water, squeeze dry and divide between 4 small ovenproof dishes.
Mix the crème fraîche, chives and horseradish and season. Flake the mackerel into the dishes and spoon the cream over.
Crack 2 eggs into each, season, cover with foil and bake 13 to 15 minutes until the whites set. Serve with lemon wedges.

title: Strawberry Banana Oatmeal
source: High Performance Recipe Book (Elysium Health & Fitness)

lines.food: Cereals, oats, regular and quick, not fortified, dry
Beverages, almond milk, unsweetened, shelf stable

steps: Put everything in a saucepan and bring to a boil.
Lower to medium and cook, stirring often, until thick and creamy. Serve hot.

title: Roasted Rhubarb Yogurt Pots
source: High Performance Recipe Book (Elysium Health & Fitness)

lines.food: Cereals, oats, regular and quick, not fortified, dry
Nuts, coconut meat, dried (desiccated), not sweetened

steps: Heat the oven to 400°F (200°C). Roast the rhubarb with 2 tbsp honey and the lemon juice, covered, 15 to 20 minutes until very soft; cool.
Toss the oats and hazelnuts with the rest of the honey and 1 tbsp water and toast 15 to 20 minutes; add the coconut for the last 5.
Layer rhubarb and yogurt in 4 glasses and top with the crunchy oats.

title: Jalapeño Corn Muffins with Lime Yogurt
source: High Performance Recipe Book (Elysium Health & Fitness)

lines.food: Milk, lowfat, fluid, 1% milkfat, with added vitamin A and vitamin D
Onions, spring or scallions (includes tops and bulb), raw
Corn, sweet, yellow, canned, whole kernel, drained solids
Wheat flour, white, all-purpose, enriched, bleached

steps: Heat the oven to 375°F (190°C) and oil a 12-cup muffin tin.
Whisk the eggs, sour cream and milk, then add the onions, jalapeños, lime zest and corn. Fold in the polenta, flour, baking powder, a pinch of salt and most of the cheese.
Fill the cups, top with the rest of the cheese and bake 12 to 15 minutes until golden.
Stir the lime juice into the yogurt for dipping.

title: Spinach Ricotta Breakfast Pockets
source: High Performance Recipe Book (Elysium Health & Fitness)

lines.food: Tomatoes, sun-dried, packed in oil, drained
Pie crust, standard-type, frozen, ready-to-bake, enriched

steps: Heat the oven to 400°F (200°C) and line a tray. Beat 1 egg with 1 tbsp water for brushing.
Mix the ricotta, spinach, basil, tomatoes, pepper flakes, the other egg and a pinch of salt.
Cut each crust into 4 wedges, put about 3 tbsp filling on one side, fold over and seal with a fork.
Brush with egg, sprinkle with sesame and bake until golden.

title: Bacon Cream Cheese Jalapeño Poppers
source: High Performance Recipe Book (Elysium Health & Fitness)

lines.food: Onions, spring or scallions (includes tops and bulb), raw
Pork, cured, bacon, pre-sliced, cooked, pan-fried

steps: Heat the oven to 400°F (200°C) and line a tray.
Mash the cream cheese with the cheddar, onions, cilantro and garlic.
Fill the jalapeño halves, press bacon bits on top and bake about 15 minutes until soft and crisp.

title: Crispy Parmesan Polenta Bites
source: High Performance Recipe Book (Elysium Health & Fitness)

lines.food: Grapes, red or green (European type, such as Thompson seedless), raw

steps: Boil the stock, whisk in the polenta until thick, then stir in the thyme and Parmesan and season.
Spread about 1.5 cm deep in a lined loaf tin, cool, then chill an hour until firm.
Cut into 28 cubes, brush with oil, dust with a little extra polenta and bake at 400°F (200°C) about 30 minutes until crisp.
Top each with a shaving of Parmesan, arugula and half a grape on a toothpick.

title: Spiced Rainbow Veggie Kebabs
source: High Performance Recipe Book (Elysium Health & Fitness)

lines.food: Squash, summer, zucchini, includes skin, raw
Tomatoes, red, ripe, raw, year round average

steps: Mix the spices with 1 tsp salt.
Toss the squash and tomatoes with 2 tbsp oil, and the broccoli and mushrooms with 1 tbsp each. Thread onto skewers.
Grill 6 to 10 minutes, turning once.
Squeeze over the lime, drizzle with the rest of the oil and sprinkle with the spice mix. Cover 5 minutes before serving.

title: Sesame Zucchini Noodle Salad
source: High Performance Recipe Book (Elysium Health & Fitness)

lines.food: Squash, summer, zucchini, includes skin, raw

steps: Whisk the cilantro, vinegar, sesame oil, garlic, pepper flakes, sugar and 1/2 tsp salt in a big bowl.
Toss in the zucchini noodles and serve right away.

title: Coconut Couscous
source: High Performance Recipe Book (Elysium Health & Fitness)

lines.food: Onions, spring or scallions (includes tops and bulb), raw

steps: Bring the coconut milk, water and a pinch of salt to a boil.
Stir in the couscous, take off the heat and cover 5 minutes.
Fluff with a fork and stir in the green onion. Good as a side or with chicken or fish.

title: Cumin Cinnamon Baked Carrot Chips
source: High Performance Recipe Book (Elysium Health & Fitness)
steps: Heat the oven to 425°F (220°C) and line several trays.
Slice the carrots paper-thin lengthwise and toss with the oil, spices and a little salt.
Bake in one layer 12 to 15 minutes, flip and bake 5 to 8 more until crisp. Keeps 2 weeks airtight.

title: Balsamic Steak with Beets and Arugula
source: High Performance Recipe Book (Elysium Health & Fitness)

lines.food: Beef, loin, top sirloin steak, boneless, lean, raw

steps: Pound the steak about ½ cm thick, halve it and marinate in the vinegar, thyme, grated garlic, half the oil and pepper.
Cook the onions and sliced garlic in the rest of the oil 8 to 10 minutes until soft and browning. Boil the beans until just tender.
Sear the steaks 2½ to 3 minutes a side, then rest and slice.
Warm the beets, olives and leftover marinade in the pan and spoon over the steak and beans with the arugula.

title: Turkey and Pepper Curry
source: High Performance Recipe Book (Elysium Health & Fitness)

lines.food: Turkey, all classes, breast, meat only, roasted
Nuts, coconut milk, canned (liquid expressed from grated meat and water)

steps: Cook the onion and peppers in the oil, covered, about 5 minutes until soft.
Add the chili, garlic, ginger and spices for 2 minutes (a splash of water if it's dry).
Stir in the turkey, passata and coconut milk, bring to a boil and simmer 10 minutes until thick. Serve with rice.

title: Thai Prawn and Pineapple Fried Rice
source: High Performance Recipe Book (Elysium Health & Fitness)

lines.food: Onions, spring or scallions (includes tops and bulb), raw
Rice, white, long-grain, regular, enriched, cooked

steps: Fry the onion whites in the oil 2 minutes, then the pepper and pineapple a minute each. Stir in the curry paste and soy sauce.
Add the rice and stir-fry until hot. Push aside and scramble the eggs.
Stir in the peas, bamboo shoots and prawns for 2 minutes until hot.
Finish with the onion greens, lime juice and cilantro.

title: English Muffin Pizza
source: High Performance Recipe Book (Elysium Health & Fitness)
steps: Split and lightly toast the muffin.
Top each half with cheddar, cottage cheese and pasta sauce.
Broil until bubbling.

title: Turkish Lamb Meatloaf with Roasted Vegetables
source: High Performance Recipe Book (Elysium Health & Fitness)

lines.food: Tomato products, canned, paste, without salt added
Soup, bouillon cubes and granules, low sodium, dry
Tomatoes, red, ripe, canned, packed in tomato juice
Squash, summer, zucchini, includes skin, raw

steps: Heat the oven to 350°F (180°C) and line a loaf tin with oiled parchment.
Mix the onion, eggplant, rice, tomato paste, bouillon, dill, spices, lamb and eggs with your hands.
Pour the tomatoes into the tin, pack the meat on top, cover with foil and bake about 1 hour 40 minutes, uncovering for the last 15.
After an hour, roast the peppers, zucchini and onions tossed in oil for 40 minutes. Toss them with the vinegar, garlic and mint and serve with the sliced loaf.

title: Lemon Chicken and Vegetable Traybake
source: High Performance Recipe Book (Elysium Health & Fitness)

lines.food: Chicken, broilers or fryers, dark meat, thigh, meat only, raw

steps: Heat the oven to 400°F (200°C). Toss the celeriac, carrot and onion with a little oil and season.
Toss the chicken with a little oil and the lemon zest, put on the vegetables with the pepper and roast 25 minutes.
Add the broccolini and roast 10 minutes more. Finish with lemon juice, herbs and the last of the oil.

title: Miso Baked Cod Parcels
source: High Performance Recipe Book (Elysium Health & Fitness)

lines.food: Onions, spring or scallions (includes tops and bulb), raw

steps: Heat the oven to 400°F (200°C). Mix the miso, mirin, soy sauce, sesame oil and ginger.
Put each fillet on a sheet of foil, spoon the miso over, add the onions and cilantro and seal tightly.
Bake 8 to 10 minutes. Serve over rice with bok choy and lime.

title: Peanut Chicken Satay Skewers
source: High Performance Recipe Book (Elysium Health & Fitness)

lines.food: Peanut butter, smooth style, without salt
Chicken, broiler or fryers, breast, skinless, boneless, meat only, raw

steps: Fry the onions in the oil 5 to 6 minutes until catching, then the garlic, ginger and chili 3 to 4 minutes. Cool.
Blend with the peanut butter, yogurt and soy sauce to a coarse paste and coat the chicken. Marinate at least 30 minutes.
Thread onto skewers and broil 8 to 10 minutes until cooked and golden. Serve with lime and rice.

title: One-Pan Roast Fish with Potatoes and Tomatoes
source: High Performance Recipe Book (Elysium Health & Fitness)

lines.food: Tomatoes, red, ripe, raw, year round average

steps: Heat the oven to 350°F (180°C). Layer the potatoes in a roasting tin, drizzle with a little oil, season and roast 25 minutes.
Soften the onions in 1 tbsp oil 5 minutes, add the garlic for 2.
Spread over the potatoes, then add the tomatoes, herbs and fish. Drizzle with oil and lemon juice, season and bake 10 to 12 minutes until the fish flakes.

title: Salmon Piccata
source: High Performance Recipe Book (Elysium Health & Fitness)

lines.food: Wheat flour, white, all-purpose, enriched, bleached

steps: Season the salmon and dust it with flour.
Sear in 1 tbsp butter and the oil 4 minutes a side, then keep warm.
Melt the rest of the butter, cook the garlic, add the wine and reduce almost to nothing. Add most of the stock and the lemon juice and boil 3 minutes.
Whisk the cornstarch into the remaining stock, stir in until slightly thick, add the capers and turn the salmon in the sauce. Finish with parsley.

title: Garlic Shrimp with Lemon Quinoa
source: High Performance Recipe Book (Elysium Health & Fitness)
steps: Sauté the prawns in 2 tsp oil with salt and half the chili powder until just pink; set aside.
Soften the onion in the rest of the oil, add the garlic, quinoa, cayenne and the rest of the chili and toast 2 minutes.
Add the stock, cover and simmer 12 to 15 minutes until tender. Fluff, stir in lemon zest, juice and parsley, and top with the prawns.

title: Turkey Mushroom Sloppy Joes
source: High Performance Recipe Book (Elysium Health & Fitness)

lines.food: Tomato products, canned, paste, without salt added
Rolls, hamburger or hot dog, whole wheat

steps: Brown the turkey, then add the onion and mushrooms for 5 minutes.
Stir in the tomato paste and water until smooth, then the garlic, spices, vinegar, sugar, oregano, salt and pepper.
Simmer 15 to 20 minutes until thick. Serve on toasted buns with onion and cilantro.

title: Salmon, Kale and Golden Beet Salad
source: High Performance Recipe Book (Elysium Health & Fitness)

lines.food: Fish, salmon, pink, canned, without salt, solids with bone and liquid

steps: Boil most of the vinegar with 120 ml water and 2 tsp honey, add the onion for 1 minute, stand 10 minutes and drain.
Pierce the beets, wrap in parchment and microwave about 7 minutes until tender; peel and cut into wedges.
Whisk the remaining vinegar and honey with the oil, mustard, salt and pepper, and toss with the beets and kale.
Top with the salmon, pickled onion and almonds.

title: Sesame Beef with Peppers
source: High Performance Recipe Book (Elysium Health & Fitness)

lines.food: Beef, flank, steak, separable lean only, trimmed to 0" fat, choice, raw
Onions, spring or scallions (includes tops and bulb), raw

steps: Mix both soy sauces, the sugar and water; marinate the steak in half (30 minutes or overnight).
Fry the garlic in the sesame oil a minute, then sear the steak 1 to 2 minutes a side. Add the pepper for a minute.
Pour in the reserved sauce, then stir in the cornstarch mixed with 1 tbsp water until it thickens. Top with green onion and sesame.

title: Shrimp, Leek and Pea Spaghetti
source: High Performance Recipe Book (Elysium Health & Fitness)
steps: Cook the pasta, saving 120 ml of the water.
Season the prawns and cook in half the oil over high heat until done; set aside.
Cook the leek and garlic in the rest of the oil until tender, then add the peas, cream, lemon zest and juice and the pasta water and simmer until slightly thick.
Toss in the prawns and pasta and finish with dill.

title: Almond Chocolate Hazelnut Crumble Bars
source: High Performance Recipe Book (Elysium Health & Fitness)
steps: Heat the oven to 350°F (180°C) and line a 9-inch square pan.
Mix the almond flour and sweetener, then the coconut oil and vanilla.
Press about three quarters into the pan and bake 10 to 15 minutes until golden at the edges; cool.
Spread with the warmed chocolate spread, crumble the rest of the dough on top and bake 10 to 15 minutes more. Cool and cut into 16.

title: Protein Apple Pie Tarts
source: High Performance Recipe Book (Elysium Health & Fitness)

lines.food: Wheat flour, white, all-purpose, enriched, bleached
Peanut butter, smooth style, without salt
Cereals, oats, regular and quick, not fortified, dry

steps: Whisk the flour, 1 scoop of protein and a pinch of salt, cut in the shortening, add water to make a dough and chill 30 minutes.
Toss the apples with lemon juice, then with the peanut butter, the other scoop of protein, oats, sugar and cinnamon.
Roll the dough about ½ cm thick, cut circles and press into a greased muffin tin. Fill and crimp.
Bake at 350°F (180°C) 20 to 25 minutes until golden.

title: Chocolate Cherry Protein Ice Cream
source: High Performance Recipe Book (Elysium Health & Fitness)

lines.food: Beverages, almond milk, unsweetened, shelf stable

steps: Mix the milk, protein powder, cocoa and vanilla and pour into an ice cream maker.
Churn, adding the cherries, 15 to 20 minutes until thick. Eat right away.

title: Turkey Sausage and Pepper Frittata
source: Hungry for More: The AF Meal Prep Recipe eBook (Anytime Fitness)
steps: Heat the broiler. Brown the turkey in 1 tbsp oil in a large ovenproof pan, about 5 minutes, and set aside.
Cook the onion and peppers in the rest of the oil 10 minutes until soft and caramelized.
Beat the eggs with salt. Return the meat to the pan, lower the heat, pour in the eggs and cook about 5 minutes until the edges set.
Scatter the oregano and broil 2 minutes until the top is set. Rest 5 minutes and cut into wedges.

title: 2-Minute Microwave Breakfast Sandwich
source: Hungry for More: The AF Meal Prep Recipe eBook (Anytime Fitness)

lines.food: Tomatoes, red, ripe, raw, year round average

source: Hungry for More: The AF Meal Prep Recipe eBook (Anytime Fitness)

Broil the peppers 8 to 10 minutes until charred, cover 10 minutes, then peel and seed.
Blend the peppers with the chickpeas, almond butter, oil, garlic and salt until smooth.
Spread a thin layer on each tortilla, add the vegetables and arugula and roll tightly.

title: Roasted Brussels Sprouts and Quinoa Salad

Simmer the quinoa in the broth, covered, about 20 minutes until absorbed.
Toss the vegetables with the chickpeas, quinoa, the last tablespoon of oil and the pepper flakes.

Combine the chicken, sauce, zucchini, tortilla strips and green onion in an ovenproof skillet with the oil and cook 5 to 6 minutes over medium heat.
Top with the cheese (or avocado) and broil 4 to 5 minutes.

title: Baked Sweet and Sour Chicken
source: Hungry for More: The AF Meal Prep Recipe eBook (Anytime Fitness)

lines.food: Chicken, broiler or fryers, breast, skinless, boneless, meat only, raw

steps: Heat the oven to 325°F (160°C) and grease a 9x13 dish. Whisk the sugar, vinegar, ketchup, soy sauce and garlic.
Season the chicken, toss in the cornstarch, dip in the egg and brown quickly in the hot oil (it doesn't need to cook through).
Put the chicken in the dish, pour over the sauce and bake 20 to 25 minutes, turning now and then, until the sauce is thick and the chicken reaches 165°F (74°C). Serve over brown rice.

title: Chicken and Sweet Potato Sheet Pan Bake
source: Hungry for More: The AF Meal Prep Recipe eBook (Anytime Fitness)

lines.food: Chicken, broiler or fryers, breast, skinless, boneless, meat only, raw

Toss the broccoli, sweet potato, onion, garlic and cranberries with the oil, seasoning, salt and pepper. Cover with foil and bake 12 minutes.
Add the chicken, toss and bake 15 to 20 minutes more until cooked and the potato is soft.

title: Portobello Mushroom Fajitas
source: Hungry for More: The AF Meal Prep Recipe eBook (Anytime Fitness)
steps: Cook the mushrooms, peppers and onion in the oil over medium-high heat about 10 minutes until soft and the liquid has cooked off.
Stir in the seasoning for a few minutes, adding a splash of water if needed.
Fill the tortillas and finish with cilantro and lime.

title: Southwest Chorizo Quinoa Stuffed Peppers

Corn, sweet, yellow, canned, whole kernel, drained solids
Tomatoes, red, ripe, raw, year round average

Brown the chorizo in the oil with the cumin, fajita seasoning and garlic.
Mix the meat, quinoa, beans, corn, tomatoes and green onion with the cilantro and lime.
Stuff the seeded peppers in a greased dish and bake 20 minutes, then add the cheese and bake 5 to 10 more.

title: Lemon Rosemary Roast Chicken
source: Hungry for More: The AF Meal Prep Recipe eBook (Anytime Fitness)

lines.food: Chicken, broilers or fryers, meat only, raw

steps: Heat the oven to 375°F (190°C). Mix the oil, rosemary, garlic, lemon zest and salt and rub over the chicken.
Put it in a roasting pan, pour the stock around and squeeze over the lemon.
Roast 50 to 60 minutes until the thickest part reads 165°F (74°C). Rest 10 minutes and carve (skip the skin to keep it lean).

title: Slow Cooker Black Bean Chicken Chili

title: Portuguese Kale and Sausage Soup

Beans, kidney, red, mature seeds, canned, drained solids

Add the garlic, leeks and kale and cook 3 to 4 minutes until soft.
Add the beans, broth and pepper, bring to a boil and simmer 30 minutes. Freezes well.

Stir in the nut butter and chocolate chips.
Roll heaped teaspoons into balls and freeze at least 2 hours.

title: Citrus Salad with Honey and Thyme
source: Hungry for More: The AF Meal Prep Recipe eBook (Anytime Fitness)

Whisk the honey, lemon juice and a pinch of salt, drizzle over and scatter with thyme leaves.

Spread on a tray and bake 35 to 40 minutes, stirring once, until crisp.

Line it with the banana slices, then the oats, then the berries.
Whisk the milk, 1.5 cups water, honey and egg and pour over. Top with walnuts.
Bake 20 to 25 minutes until set.

title: Banana Protein Pancakes
source: A Clean Plate: 21-Day Transformation Meal Prep Guide (Anytime Fitness)
steps: Mix everything well.
Cook 2-tbsp pancakes in a greased pan over medium heat about a minute a side (the batter is thinner than usual). Makes about 9.

title: Grab-and-Go Mini Quiches
source: A Clean Plate: 21-Day Transformation Meal Prep Guide (Anytime Fitness)
steps: Whisk the eggs with salt and pepper and stir in the chopped vegetables, ham and cheese.
Pour into a greased 12-cup muffin tin and bake at 350°F (175°C) 25 minutes.
Keep in the fridge; reheat 20 to 30 seconds wrapped in a paper towel.

title: Chocolate Protein Overnight Oats

Milk, lowfat, fluid, 1% milkfat, with added vitamin A and vitamin D

Divide into 3 jars, top with banana and chill 1 to 2 hours or overnight.

Simmer the quinoa in 4 cups water, covered, about 12 minutes.
Fry the eggs one at a time.
Build each bowl with quinoa, roasted veg and an egg, and add a spoon of yogurt.

title: Loaded Mediterranean Turkey Sandwich
source: A Clean Plate: 21-Day Transformation Meal Prep Guide (Anytime Fitness)

Layer the turkey, spinach, avocado, onion and apple, close and cut in half. Serve with sliced peppers.

Put the spinach in a bowl and top with the rice, chickpeas, tomatoes, sliced avocado and egg, and the goat cheese.
Pour on the dressing.

title: Avocado Chicken Egg Salad

Peanut butter, smooth style, without salt

steps: Marinate the chicken 20 minutes in the olive oil, 3 tbsp soy sauce, garlic, ginger and ½ tbsp sesame oil.
Cook the quinoa in 2 cups water, covered, 15 to 20 minutes.
Cook the chicken with its marinade until it reaches 165°F (74°C), then shred.
Whisk the vinegar, the rest of the sesame oil and soy sauce, the sugar and peanut butter into a sauce and add the peanuts.
Fill lettuce leaves with quinoa, chicken, cucumber and carrot and drizzle with sauce.

title: 5-Ingredient BBQ Black Bean Burgers

lines.food: Beans, black, mature seeds, canned, low sodium
Cereals, oats, regular and quick, not fortified, dry
Rolls, hamburger or hot dog, whole wheat

steps: Heat the oven to 400°F (200°C) and line a tray.
Mash the beans to a chunky paste, then stir in the barbecue sauce, spices and oats.
Shape 3 patties with wet hands and bake 15 minutes, flip and bake 10 more until firm.
Serve in buns with your toppings.

title: Sheet Pan Chicken Fajitas
source: A Clean Plate: 21-Day Transformation Meal Prep Guide (Anytime Fitness)

lines.food: Chicken, broiler or fryers, breast, skinless, boneless, meat only, raw

steps: Heat the oven to 375°F (190°C) and line a large tray.
Toss the chicken, peppers and onion with the oil and seasoning and spread out.
Bake 20 to 22 minutes until the chicken is cooked. Serve in corn tortillas or over rice.

title: Sheet Pan Steak with Potatoes and Asparagus

Beef, loin, top sirloin steak, boneless, lean, raw

Toss the potatoes with the oil, garlic, thyme, salt and pepper and cook 20 minutes.
Add the seasoned steak, asparagus and tomatoes and broil until the steak is charred and done to your liking.

source: A Clean Plate: 21-Day Transformation Meal Prep Guide (Anytime Fitness)

Shred, return to the juices for 10 minutes and serve in tortillas with beans, corn, avocado or Greek yogurt.

Mix in everything else and roll into 12 balls. Chill at least 2 hours. A serving is 2 bites.

title: Watermelon Avocado Salad

Add the watermelon and cilantro and salt to taste.

title: Sweet and Spicy Pumpkin Seeds

steps: Toast the seeds in a dry pan over medium heat about 4 minutes, stirring, until they start to pop.
Toss with the oil, sugar, spices and a pinch of salt and cayenne, then spread on paper towel to cool 10 minutes.

title: Baked Mozzarella Bites with Marinara
steps: Heat the oven to 425°F (220°C). Toast the panko in a dry pan 2 minutes.
Cut the cheese into 1-inch pieces, dip in egg white and roll in the panko.
Bake on a greased tray about 3 minutes until just soft. Serve with warm marinara.

title: Crunchy Roasted Chickpeas

lines.food: Chickpeas (garbanzo beans, bengal gram), mature seeds, canned, drained, rinsed in tap water

steps: Heat the oven to 300°F (150°C). Rub the chickpeas in a towel to loosen the skins and discard them.
Toss with the oil, spices, garlic and salt and spread on a tray.
Bake about 1 hour 40 minutes, stirring every 20, until crunchy.

title: Grilled Bacon and Cheese Stuffed Jalapeños

lines.food: Pork, cured, bacon, pre-sliced, cooked, pan-fried
Onions, spring or scallions (includes tops and bulb), raw
Tomatoes, red, ripe, raw, year round average

steps: Crisp and crumble the bacon.
Mix it with both cream cheeses, cheddar, green onion, lime juice, garlic and salt, and fill the pepper halves.
Grill cheese side up on a greased grate over medium-high, covered, about 8 minutes until charred underneath.
Scatter with cilantro and tomato.

title: Light Spinach Artichoke Dip

lines.food: Artichokes, (globe or french), cooked, boiled, drained, without salt

lines.t: 10 oz frozen spinach, thawed and squeezed

lines.food: Cream, fluid, light (coffee cream or table cream)

steps: Heat the oven to 350°F (175°C).
Mix the sour cream, garlic, artichokes, spinach, both cream cheeses, pepper, two-thirds of the mozzarella and half the Parmesan.
Spread in a 1½-quart baking dish, top with the rest of the cheese and bake 30 minutes until bubbling, then broil 3 minutes to brown.

title: Chocolate Granola Apple Wedges
steps: Melt the chocolate in the microwave in 15-second bursts.
Dip one side of each apple wedge in chocolate, then in the granola.
Chill on a plate 5 minutes to set.

title: Carrot Cake Sandwich Cookies

lines.food: Wheat flour, white, all-purpose, enriched, bleached
Cream, fluid, light (coffee cream or table cream)

steps: Heat the oven to 350°F (175°C). Toss the carrot with 3 tbsp of the brown sugar and drain 10 minutes.

Whisk half the butter (melted) with the oil, zest, most of the vanilla and the egg. Mix the flour, remaining brown sugar, cinnamon, baking soda and a pinch of salt, then stir in the carrot and butter mixture.
Drop 28 tablespoons onto lined trays, flatten slightly and bake 11 minutes. Cool.
Beat the cream cheese with the rest of the butter and vanilla, add the powdered sugar, and sandwich the cookies in pairs.

title: Hazelnut Cherry Chocolate Bark
steps: Toast the hazelnuts at 350°F (175°C) 20 minutes, rub off the skins in a towel and chop. Mix with the cherries and ginger.
Melt the chocolate, stir in the nut mix and spread thin on a foil-lined tray.
Freeze 1 hour and break into pieces.

title: Banana Oatmeal Chocolate Chip Cookies

lines.food: Wheat flour, white, all-purpose, enriched, bleached
Cereals, oats, regular and quick, not fortified, dry

steps: Heat the oven to 350°F (175°C).
Beat the banana, sugars, butter and vanilla smooth, then beat in the egg.
Mix the flour, oats, baking soda and a pinch of salt, beat into the banana mix and stir in the chips.
Drop heaped tablespoons onto greased trays and bake 18 minutes until golden.

title: Pumpkin Cranberry Muffins

lines.food: Wheat flour, white, all-purpose, enriched, bleached

steps: Heat the oven to 375°F (190°C) and line a 12-cup muffin tin.
Whisk the flour, baking soda, spices, baking powder and a pinch of salt and cloves.
Beat the sugar, pumpkin, buttermilk, brown sugar, oil and egg about 3 minutes, then stir in the dry mix and cranberries.
Bake 25 minutes until they spring back.

title: Mushroom Spinach Hash Brown Egg Bake

lines.food: Pork, cured, bacon, pre-sliced, cooked, pan-fried
Potatoes, hash brown, frozen, plain, unprepared
Milk, lowfat, fluid, 1% milkfat, with added vitamin A and vitamin D

steps: Heat the oven to 350°F (175°C). Crisp and crumble the bacon.
Sauté the onion, mushrooms and garlic in the drippings 6 minutes, add the potatoes and stock for 6, then the spinach and basil until wilted. Cool 10 minutes, then stir in the bacon and cheese.
Spread in a greased 11x7 dish, pour over the eggs beaten with the milk, salt and pepper and bake 28 minutes.
Broil 3 minutes to brown and rest 5.

title: Coconut Breakfast Quinoa with Berries

lines.food: Nuts, coconut meat, dried (desiccated), not sweetened

steps: Rinse the quinoa well.
Simmer it with the coconut milk, 2 tbsp water, sugar and a pinch of salt about 15 minutes until absorbed, stirring at the end.
Toast the coconut at 400°F (200°C) 5 minutes.
Serve warm topped with strawberries, banana and coconut.

title: Huevos Rancheros Tacos

lines.food: Beans, black, mature seeds, canned, low sodium

steps: Broil the greased tortillas 2 minutes, flip, top with cheese and beans and broil 1 minute more.
Fry the eggs in the oil 2 minutes, then cover 2 minutes until the whites set.
Put an egg on each tortilla and top with pico, sour cream, avocado and cilantro. Serve with lime.

title: Buttermilk Oatmeal Pancakes

lines.food: Wheat flour, white, all-purpose, enriched, bleached
Cereals, oats, regular and quick, not fortified, dry

steps: Whisk the dry ingredients with a pinch of salt.
Whisk the buttermilk, butter and egg and stir in just until moist.
Cook 2½-tbsp pancakes on a greased griddle over medium heat, flipping when bubbles cover the top.

title: Steel-Cut Oats with Blueberry Compote

lines.food: Cereals, oats, regular and quick, not fortified, dry

steps: The night before: toss the blueberries with the sugar, lemon zest and juice and half the cinnamon and chill. Boil 4 cups water, stir in the oats, the rest of the cinnamon and a pinch of salt, cook 1 minute, cover and refrigerate.
In the morning: boil the blueberries about 6 minutes until slightly thick, and reheat the oats 5 minutes, stirring in the butter.
Serve the oats topped with the compote.

title: Greek Chicken Hummus Wraps

lines.food: Tomatoes, red, ripe, raw, year round average
Chicken, broilers or fryers, breast, meat only, cooked, roasted

Spread each tortilla with a tablespoon of hummus, add about ½ cup of the filling, roll up and cut in half.

title: Crispy Quinoa Black Bean Quesadillas

lines.food: Corn, sweet, yellow, canned, whole kernel, drained solids

steps: Heat the broiler with a tray inside.
Cook the poblano and corn in the oil 5 minutes, add the quinoa and spinach until wilted, then stir in the cheese.
Mash the beans with the hot sauce, spread over 4 tortillas, top with the spinach mixture and the other tortillas.
Spray lightly and broil on the hot tray about 3 minutes, turning once. Cut into wedges; serve with sour cream and lime.

title: Garlicky Grilled Cheese with Bacon and Greens

steps: Sauté the garlic in the oil 1 minute, wilt the spinach and arugula and set aside. Crisp the bacon in the same pan.
Build 4 sandwiches with the cheeses, bacon and greens.
Cook in the drippings over medium heat, pressed with a plate, 2 minutes a side.

title: Lemony Orzo Chicken Salad

Onions, spring or scallions (includes tops and bulb), raw

steps: Cook the orzo, rinse under cold water and drain.
Whisk the lemon zest and juice, oil, a pinch of salt, garlic, honey and pepper and toss with the orzo.
Add the chicken, cucumber, pepper, green onion and dill and top with the goat cheese.

title: White Bean Turkey Chili

lines.food: Beans, great northern, mature seeds, canned
Turkey, all classes, breast, meat only, roasted
Tomatoes, red, ripe, raw, year round average

Add the oregano and beans, then the broth, and simmer 20 minutes.
Blend 2 cups and stir back in to thicken. Add the turkey for 5 minutes.
Off the heat, stir in the tomato, cilantro, lime juice, salt and pepper.

title: Bacon Burger with Bourbon BBQ Onions

lines.food: Pork, cured, bacon, pre-sliced, cooked, pan-fried
Beef, ground, 90% lean meat / 10% fat, raw
Rolls, hamburger or hot dog, whole wheat
Tomatoes, red, ripe, raw, year round average

steps: Crisp the bacon. Cook the onions in the drippings with the oil about 15 minutes until soft and brown, then add 3 tbsp bourbon, the vinegar and a pinch of salt and cook off.
Simmer the rest of the bourbon with the ketchup, mustard, honey, hot sauce, Worcestershire and spices 5 minutes into a sauce.
Mix ¾ cup chopped onions into the beef and shape 6 thin patties with a dent in the middle. Grill 4 minutes a side.
Spread the buns with sauce and build with the patty, tomato, remaining onions and half a slice of bacon.

title: Chicken with Brussels Sprouts and Mustard Sauce

lines.food: Chicken, broiler or fryers, breast, skinless, boneless, meat only, raw
Apple juice, canned or bottled, unsweetened, without added ascorbic acid

steps: Heat the oven to 450°F (230°C). Brown the seasoned chicken in 1 tbsp oil 3 minutes, turn and roast 9 minutes until done; keep warm.
Boil most of the stock and the cider in the pan, scraping up the bits, then simmer 4 minutes and whisk in the mustard, half the butter and the parsley.
Brown the sprouts in the rest of the oil and butter 2 minutes, add the last of the stock, cover and cook 4 minutes. Serve with the chicken and sauce.

title: Sweet Potato Cauliflower Chickpea Curry

lines.food: Chickpeas (garbanzo beans, bengal gram), mature seeds, canned, drained, rinsed in tap water
Tomatoes, red, ripe, canned, packed in tomato juice

steps: Sauté the sweet potato in the oil 3 minutes, then add the cauliflower, onion and curry powder for 1 minute.
Add the stock, salt, chickpeas and tomatoes, bring to a boil, cover and simmer 10 minutes until tender.
Top with cilantro and serve with yogurt.

title: Ginger Shrimp and Broccoli Stir-Fry

lines.food: Onions, spring or scallions (includes tops and bulb), raw

steps: Toss the shrimp in the cornstarch and stir-fry in 1 tbsp oil 4 minutes; set aside.
Stir-fry the green onion, ginger and garlic in a little oil 45 seconds and add to the shrimp.
Stir-fry the broccoli in the rest of the oil 1½ minutes, then add everything back with the soy sauce, vinegar, honey and pepper flakes and boil 1 minute.

title: Flat Iron Steak with Arugula Parmesan Salad

lines.food: Beef, shoulder top blade steak, boneless, separable lean only, trimmed to 0" fat, all grades, raw

steps: Rub the steaks with thyme, salt and pepper and cook in a hot grill pan 4 minutes a side. Grill the lemon halves cut side down 3 minutes. Slice the steak.
Whisk the chives, oil, lemon juice, mustard and salt and toss with the arugula.
Plate the steak with the salad, a grilled lemon half and the Parmesan.

title: Smoky Fish Tacos with Avocado
steps: Heat the broiler. Mix the spices with salt and pepper, brush the fish with oil, sprinkle on the spices and broil about 6 minutes until it flakes.
Mash the avocado lightly with the cilantro, chiles and a pinch of salt.
Char the tortillas in a hot pan and fill with fish and avocado. Serve with lime.

title: Chicken Enchilada Casserole with Salsa Verde

lines.food: Chicken, broilers or fryers, dark meat, thigh, meat only, raw
Corn, sweet, yellow, canned, whole kernel, drained solids
Cream, fluid, light (coffee cream or table cream)

steps: Heat the oven to 425°F (220°C). Brown the chicken 4 minutes a side, roast 10 minutes, cool and shred. Mix with a little cilantro, the corn, cream cheese and spices.
Soften ½ cup onion and half the garlic and add to the chicken.
Simmer the rest of the onion and garlic with the stock, salsa, ¼ cup water and jalapeños 15 minutes, then blend with some cilantro.
Toast the tortillas, quarter them and layer sauce, tortillas and chicken twice in a greased 8-inch dish, ending with tortillas. Pour over the rest of the sauce, add the cheddar and bake 15 minutes.

title: Steak Baguette with Pesto Mayo

lines.food: Beef, loin, top sirloin steak, boneless, lean, raw
Tomatoes, red, ripe, raw, year round average

steps: Season the steak and cook in a hot grill pan 2½ minutes a side; rest 5 minutes and slice thinly.
Mix the mayonnaise and pesto and spread on the cut baguette.
Layer arugula, onion, steak and tomato, close and cut into 4.

title: Chili Garlic Glazed Salmon

lines.food: Onions, spring or scallions (includes tops and bulb), raw

steps: Heat the broiler. Mix the chili sauce, green onion, marmalade and soy sauce.
Brush half over the salmon on a greased tray and broil 5 minutes.
Brush with the rest and broil 2 more minutes until it flakes.

lines.t: 1 lb pork tenderloin, cut into 12 pieces
lines.food: Beef, tenderloin, steak, separable lean only, trimmed to 1/8" fat, all grades, raw
Apple juice, canned or bottled, unsweetened, without added ascorbic acid

Melt the butter and sauté the apples and shallots 4 minutes until browning, then add the cider for 2 minutes. Stir in the thyme and serve with the pork.

title: Sausage Huevos Rancheros Skillet

lines.food: Sausage, chicken, beef, pork, skinless, smoked
