steps: Fry the onion and garlic in the oil, then brown the sliced sausages.
Add the pepper and chili for a minute, then the tomatoes, cumin, salt and pepper; simmer 5 minutes.
Make 3 hollows, crack in the eggs and simmer 3 minutes, then finish under the broiler until the whites set. Sprinkle with cheese.

title: Mint Ginger Green Smoothie

lines.food: Squash, summer, zucchini, includes skin, raw
Beverages, almond milk, unsweetened, shelf stable

steps: Blend everything until smooth (pre-chopped and frozen makes it colder).

title: Thai Sweet Potato and Squash Soup

lines.t: 2 cups roasted sweet potato and squash purée
lines.food: Sweet potato, cooked, baked in skin, flesh, without salt
Nuts, coconut milk, canned (liquid expressed from grated meat and water)

steps: For the purée, roast chunks of sweet potato and squash with a little oil and salt at 400°F (200°C) 35 to 40 minutes, then blend.
Soften the onion in the coconut oil 5 minutes, then the lemongrass, ginger, garlic and cilantro stems.
Add the purée, stock and coconut milk and bring to a boil.
Blend smooth and top with chili and cilantro.

title: Shrimp Salad with Avocado Dressing

lines.food: Seeds, pumpkin and squash seed kernels, dried

steps: Spread the lettuce, cucumber and radishes on a platter.
Blend the avocado, vinegar, garlic, mustard and oil smooth and season.
Drizzle over the salad and scatter with the shrimp and seeds (add a can of chickpeas for a bigger meal).

title: Layered Feta Rice Salad Jar

lines.food: Onions, spring or scallions (includes tops and bulb), raw

steps: Whisk the oil, mustard and lemon juice with salt and pepper and pour into the bottom of a jar.
Layer the pepper, cucumber and green onion, then the rice, then the greens and herbs, and top with feta.
Seal and only shake it together when you eat.

title: Spicy No-Mayo Coleslaw with Cashews
steps: Toss the cabbages, carrots and chili.
Whisk the honey, lime juice and zest, vinegar, salt and pepper and toss through. Let it sit.
Just before eating, add the chopped cilantro and toasted cashews. Keeps a couple of days.

title: Green Vegetable Frittata
steps: Soften the onion in the oil on low, then cook the asparagus, beans and peppers until tender. Add the garlic, then wilt the spinach and basil. Season.
Put the vegetables in a baking dish, pour over the beaten eggs and press in some feta.
Bake at 300°F (150°C) 15 to 20 minutes until just set.

title: Roasted Thai Cauliflower Curry

lines.food: Peanut butter, smooth style, without salt
Nuts, coconut milk, canned (liquid expressed from grated meat and water)
Nuts, coconut meat, dried (desiccated), not sweetened

steps: Heat the oven and a tray to 400°F (200°C). Roast the cauliflower and squash with the oil, salt and pepper 30 to 40 minutes.
Blend the garlic, ginger, chili, turmeric, onion, peanut butter, lime juice and zest, herbs, sesame oil and soy sauce to a paste, then blend in the coconut milk and stock.
Pour over the vegetables and cook 5 to 10 minutes. Top with toasted coconut and mint or cilantro.

title: Chili Chicken and Mango Salad

lines.food: Onions, spring or scallions (includes tops and bulb), raw
Chicken, broilers or fryers, breast, meat only, cooked, roasted

steps: Mix the mango and its juice with the green onion, chili and lime juice.
Add the lettuce, most of the cilantro and the chicken, then the oils, and toss. Top with the rest of the cilantro.

title: Pepper Shakshuka

lines.food: Tomatoes, red, ripe, canned, packed in tomato juice
Tomato products, canned, paste, without salt added

steps: Soften the onions in the oil, then the peppers and garlic for 5 to 10 minutes.
Stir in the tomatoes, tomato paste, spices, salt and pepper until hot.
Crack the eggs on top, cover and cook until set. Finish with parsley or cilantro.

title: Zucchini Noodles with Roasted Red Pepper Sauce

lines.food: Squash, summer, zucchini, includes skin, raw

steps: Roast the peppers and the foil-wrapped garlic at 400°F (200°C) about 30 minutes until blackened.
Cover the peppers 10 minutes, peel and seed them, squeeze out the garlic and blend both with the oil and salt.
Toss the hot sauce through the zucchini noodles (add chicken or sautéed mushrooms for a fuller meal).

title: Almond Flax Chicken Nuggets with Veg Fries

lines.food: Chicken, broiler or fryers, breast, skinless, boneless, meat only, raw
Milk, lowfat, fluid, 1% milkfat, with added vitamin A and vitamin D

steps: Heat the oven to 375°F (190°C).
Dip the chicken in egg beaten with the milk, then in the almond and flax mix, and lay on a lined tray.
Cut the carrots and parsnip into chunky fries, toss with the oil, salt and pepper on another tray.
Bake both 25 minutes. Good with guacamole or salsa.

title: Easy Guacamole

lines.food: Tomatoes, red, ripe, raw, year round average

steps: Mash the avocado and mix in everything else with a pinch of salt.

title: Zucchini Noodle Sausage Bolognese

lines.food: Sausage, chicken, beef, pork, skinless, smoked
Tomatoes, red, ripe, canned, packed in tomato juice
Nuts, coconut cream, raw (liquid expressed from grated meat)
Artichokes, (globe or french), cooked, boiled, drained, without salt
Squash, summer, zucchini, includes skin, raw

steps: Brown the sausage in the oil, then add the onion, leek and pepper until tender.
Warm the tomatoes with the coconut cream, garlic and rosemary.
Add the zucchini and artichokes to the pan, pour the sauce over and cook 5 to 6 minutes, keeping the zucchini al dente.

title: Seedy Carrot Oat Cookies

lines.food: Cereals, oats, regular and quick, not fortified, dry
Seeds, pumpkin and squash seed kernels, dried

steps: Heat the oven to 350°F (180°C). Mix the flour, oats, baking soda, sugar, cinnamon, seeds and nuts.
Melt the coconut oil with the syrup, stir in the carrot, then mix into the dry ingredients.
Roll teaspoons into about 20 balls on a tray and bake 10 to 15 minutes.

title: Mango Banana Nice Cream

lines.food: Nuts, coconut milk, canned (liquid expressed from grated meat and water)

steps: Blend everything in a food processor until smooth and eat right away, or freeze for later.

title: Chocolate Avocado Mousse

lines.food: Nuts, almond butter, plain, without salt added

steps: Blend everything with a pinch of salt until smooth.
Spoon into small dishes and chill. Top with berries or cacao nibs.

title: Microwave Green Eggs and Ham

lines.food: Milk, lowfat, fluid, 1% milkfat, with added vitamin A and vitamin D
Tomatoes, red, ripe, raw, year round average

steps: Whisk the eggs and milk in a microwave-safe bowl and stir in the ham, cheese and tomato.
Microwave 30 seconds, stir, then about 80 seconds more until fluffy.
Serve on a bed of spinach with salt and pepper.

title: Two-Ingredient Banana Pancakes
steps: Mash the banana and stir in the eggs.
Cook small pancakes in a greased pan over medium heat about a minute a side.
Top with granola, a little maple syrup and cinnamon.

title: Key Lime Pie Protein Smoothie

lines.food: Beverages, almond milk, unsweetened, shelf stable

steps: Blend everything until smooth, with ice if you like.

title: Open-Faced Sunny Side Avocado Toast

lines.food: Tomatoes, red, ripe, raw, year round average

steps: Fry the egg in a lightly greased pan with a lid on, 1 to 2 minutes.
Spread the toast with avocado and add the spinach and tomato.
Top with the egg, salt and pepper.

title: Honey Yogurt Avocado Toast
steps: Toast the bread. Mix the yogurt with the honey and vanilla and spread it on.
Cover with thin avocado slices, add a little more honey and a pinch of salt.

title: Potato Onion Frittata
steps: Cook the potato and onion in the oil over medium heat about 15 minutes until nearly soft.
Pour in the eggs beaten with salt and cook undisturbed about 8 minutes until set on top. Cut into wedges.

title: Banana Blueberry Protein Mug Muffin

lines.food: Milk, lowfat, fluid, 1% milkfat, with added vitamin A and vitamin D

steps: Stir everything in a greased mug with a pinch of salt.
Microwave 1 minute, check, then up to 1 minute more until the middle is set. Cool a minute.

title: Beet and Berry Smoothie Bowl

lines.t: 1/2 cup raw beet, peeled and chopped

lines.food: Peanut butter, smooth style, without salt
Beverages, almond milk, unsweetened, shelf stable

steps: Blend everything except the granola until smooth and thick (add ice if needed).
Pour into a bowl and top with granola, berries or sliced banana.

title: Vegetarian Burrito Bowl

lines.food: Beans, black, mature seeds, canned, low sodium

steps: Microwave the rice, beans and salsa 1 to 2 minutes, stirring halfway, until hot.
Top with spinach, peppers, yogurt, cheese, avocado and more salsa.

title: Thai Peanut Chicken Salad

lines.food: Chicken, broilers or fryers, breast, meat only, cooked, roasted
Corn, sweet, yellow, canned, whole kernel, drained solids
Peanut butter, smooth style, without salt

steps: Whisk the yogurt, peanut butter, soy sauce and lime juice with salt and pepper.
Toss with the chicken, carrots, edamame, corn and pepper.

title: Southwestern Stuffed Sweet Potatoes

lines.food: Beans, black, mature seeds, canned, low sodium
Corn, sweet, yellow, canned, whole kernel, drained solids
Tomatoes, red, ripe, raw, year round average

steps: Prick the potatoes and microwave about 7 minutes until tender.
Sauté the onion with the spices in the oil 3 to 4 minutes, then add the beans, corn, tomatoes, lime and cilantro.
Split the potatoes, fluff the insides and pile in about ¼ cup filling each. Top with cheese and yogurt.

title: Watermelon Feta Arugula Salad
steps: Toss everything together with the balsamic.
For a full meal, add cooked quinoa and shredded chicken.

title: Roasted Red Pepper Provolone Focaccia

lines.food: Peppers, sweet, red, canned, solids and liquids

steps: Brush one cut side of the focaccia with oil.
Layer the peppers, cheese and arugula on the other, season and close. Cut into 4.

title: Mason Jar Greek Salad with Hummus Dressing

lines.food: Chickpeas (garbanzo beans, bengal gram), mature seeds, canned, drained, rinsed in tap water
Tomatoes, red, ripe, raw, year round average

steps: Whisk the hummus, lemon juice, garlic and salt (add water to thin) and pour into the bottom of 2 jars.
Layer the chickpeas, cucumber, tomato, olives, feta and lettuce. Keeps 3 days.

title: Ham and Cheddar Cornmeal Muffins

lines.food: Wheat flour, white, all-purpose, enriched, bleached

steps: Heat the oven to 375°F (190°C) and grease a muffin tin.
Whisk the dry ingredients with a pinch of salt, and separately the buttermilk, eggs and butter. Combine, then fold in the cheese, ham and chives.
Fill the cups and bake 20 to 25 minutes until browned.

title: BLT Avocado Turkey Roll-Ups

lines.food: Pork, cured, bacon, pre-sliced, cooked, pan-fried
Tomatoes, red, ripe, raw, year round average

steps: Spread each tortilla with avocado.
Add 3 turkey slices, a spoon of bacon bits, tomato and lettuce, season and roll tightly.
Slice into rounds.

title: Pineapple Teriyaki Chicken Stir-Fry

lines.food: Chicken, broiler or fryers, breast, skinless, boneless, meat only, raw
Squash, summer, zucchini, includes skin, raw

steps: Whisk the soy sauce, ¼ cup water, sugar, ginger, garlic and onion.
Cook the chicken with the sauce in a large pan, adding the pineapple and vegetables as you go, stirring often, about 15 minutes. Serve over brown rice.

title: Tomato Spinach Tortellini Soup

lines.food: Tomatoes, red, ripe, canned, packed in tomato juice

steps: Soften the onion in the oil with a pinch of salt, then the garlic for a minute.
Add the tomatoes and broth and simmer.
Add the tortellini and cook as the package says. Season with pepper.

title: BBQ Chicken and Black Bean Quesadillas

lines.food: Chicken, broilers or fryers, breast, meat only, cooked, roasted
Beans, black, mature seeds, canned, low sodium

steps: Mix the chicken and beans with the barbecue sauce.
Mix the onion, jalapeño, cilantro, cheese and spices, then combine everything.
Fill each tortilla with about ⅓ cup, fold and cook in a pan until crisp. Cut in half.

title: Lemon Shrimp Scampi Pasta
steps: Cook and drain the pasta.
Cook the garlic and shallots in the oil 2 minutes, then the shrimp 3 to 4 minutes until pink.
Toss in the pasta for a minute, season and finish with lemon juice and Parmesan.

title: Roasted Vegetable Chilaquiles Stack

lines.t: 4 cups zucchini, peppers and onions, chopped
lines.food: Squash, summer, zucchini, includes skin, raw

steps: Roast the vegetables with 1 tbsp oil, salt and pepper at 400°F (200°C) 20 to 25 minutes.
Fry the eggs in the rest of the oil until the whites set.
Stack a tostada, vegetables, queso and salsa, another tostada, salsa and an egg.

title: Loaded Chicken Potato Boat

lines.food: Chicken, broilers or fryers, breast, meat only, cooked, roasted
Onions, spring or scallions (includes tops and bulb), raw

steps: Prick the potato and microwave about 7 minutes until soft.
Halve it and top with the chicken, cheese, yogurt and green onion.

title: Three-Step Chicken Provençal

lines.food: Chicken, broilers or fryers, dark meat, thigh, meat only, raw
Squash, summer, zucchini, includes skin, raw
Tomatoes, red, ripe, raw, year round average

steps: Season the chicken and sear in the oil 5 minutes on one side.
Flip, add the onion, zucchini, tomatoes and rosemary and simmer about 15 minutes until the chicken is done and the vegetables are tender.

title: Kung Pao Chickpeas with Cashews

lines.food: Chickpeas (garbanzo beans, bengal gram), mature seeds, canned, drained, rinsed in tap water

steps: Brown the chickpeas in the oil over high heat 2 to 3 minutes.
Add the garlic and ginger for 30 seconds, then the sauce for 5 minutes. Stir in the cashews.

title: Peach Jalapeño Salsa
steps: Mix everything with salt to taste and chill 30 minutes.
Great with grilled chicken or white fish, or with chips.

title: Very Berry Frozen Yogurt Bark
steps: Spread the yogurt about ½ inch thick on a parchment-lined tray.
Scatter with the almonds, berries and granola.
Freeze 1 to 2 hours and break into pieces.

title: Sweet Potato Fries with Chipotle Mayo
steps: Heat the oven to 400°F (200°C). Cut the potatoes into ½-inch fries, toss with the oil and salt and roast about 25 minutes until browned.
Whisk the mayonnaise, lemon juice and chipotle and serve on the side.

title: Spanish Zucchini Tortilla

lines.food: Squash, summer, zucchini, includes skin, raw

steps: Brown the potato and onion in the oil over medium-high heat 4 minutes, then the zucchini 4 more.
Beat the eggs with salt and pepper and mix in the vegetables.
Pour back into the pan on low, loosen the edges after 3 minutes and cook 8 to 10 minutes.
Flip it onto a plate and slide back in to cook 5 to 6 minutes more.

title: Smoked Salmon Omelet Wraps
steps: Blend the cottage cheese, watercress and lemon zest to a smooth paste.
Beat the eggs with the milk and herbs.
Cook 4 thin omelets in 1 tsp oil each, about 2 minutes, flipping for 30 seconds.
Spread with the cottage cheese, add the salmon, roll up and halve.

title: Turkey and Egg Stuffed Peppers

lines.food: Beverages, almond milk, unsweetened, shelf stable

steps: Heat the oven to 400°F (200°C). Beat the eggs, whites and milk.
Soften the onion in the oil 3 minutes, add the turkey and spices and cook through, then wilt the spinach.
Turn up the heat, add the eggs and stir about 3 minutes until set.
Halve and seed the peppers, fill, top with cheese and bake 15 minutes. Finish with parsley.

title: Smoked Salmon Feta Asparagus Omelet

lines.food: Milk, lowfat, fluid, 1% milkfat, with added vitamin A and vitamin D
Tomatoes, red, ripe, raw, year round average

steps: Cut the asparagus into short pieces and boil 2 minutes; drain.
Whisk the eggs and milk with salt and pepper and stir in the asparagus, salmon and feta.
Pour into the oiled pan, add the tomatoes, cover and cook 5 minutes, then bake uncovered at 350°F (180°C) 6 to 10 minutes until set.
Top with dill and pepper.

title: Blueberry Protein Pancake
steps: Whisk the egg whites and protein powder, then stir in the banana and blueberries (a splash of milk if it's too thick).
Cook in the oil over low-medium heat about 5 minutes until bubbles form and it's set enough to flip, then 2 to 3 minutes more. Makes 1 big or 3 small.

title: Eggs Fried in Tomatoes with Tuna

lines.food: Tomatoes, red, ripe, raw, year round average

lines.t: 80 g canned tuna in water, drained
lines.food: Fish, tuna, light, canned in water, drained solids

steps: Fry the tomato in the oil over high heat 3 minutes.
Make 2 hollows, crack in the eggs, season and scatter the tuna, oregano and chili flakes on top.
Cook about 3 minutes until the whites are set. Finish with parsley.

title: Peach Banana Protein Smoothie Bowl
steps: Blend everything except the berries until smooth and thick.
Split between 2 bowls and top with berries (or goji, walnuts, chia, muesli).

title: Mushroom Spinach Shakshuka
steps: Soften the onion and garlic in the oil 2 to 3 minutes, then the mushrooms 3 to 4.
Add the spinach in batches, covering until each wilts. Season.
Make 4 hollows, crack in the eggs, cover and cook 5 to 6 minutes until the whites set. Top with parsley.

title: Salmon Tartare with Avocado and Mango

lines.t: 100 g very fresh salmon fillet, cubed

steps: Mix the salmon, avocado and mango with the lime juice, honey, chili and cilantro. Season.
Chill at least 10 minutes. Use sushi-grade fish since it's eaten raw.

title: Tuna Apple Lettuce Wraps

lines.t: 280 g canned tuna in olive oil, drained
lines.food: Fish, tuna, light, canned in oil, drained solids
Tomato products, canned, paste, without salt added

steps: Mix the tuna with a little of its oil and the tomato paste.
Stir in the onion and apple.
Spoon into the lettuce leaves.

title: Chicken, Orange and Pecan Salad

lines.food: Chicken, broiler or fryers, breast, skinless, boneless, meat only, raw

steps: Segment the orange and squeeze the rest for juice. Whisk 2 tbsp of the juice with the honey, mustard, oil, lemon juice and cinnamon.
Cut the chicken into 4, season, rub with a little oil and grill 4 minutes a side, then brush with dressing and cook a minute more each side.
Top the leaves with orange and chicken, then pomegranate, pecans and the rest of the dressing.

title: Glazed Salmon and Peach Salad

lines.food: Corn, sweet, yellow, canned, whole kernel, drained solids
Tomatoes, red, ripe, raw, year round average

steps: Mix the vinegar, oil, tamari, syrup and pepper and marinate the salmon.
Char the corn and cut off the kernels.
Bake the salmon at 400°F (200°C) 8 to 10 minutes.
Top the leaves with peach, tomatoes, corn and salmon, drizzle with balsamic and season.

title: Tuna Broccoli Salad with Honey Lemon Dressing

lines.t: 120 g canned tuna in water, drained
lines.food: Fish, tuna, light, canned in water, drained solids

steps: Top the leaves with radish and tuna.
Toast the bread and cube it. Boil the broccoli about 5 minutes and drain.
Add both, drizzle with the oil, lemon and honey whisked together, and sprinkle with Parmesan.

title: Grilled Chicken Pineapple Mint Salad

lines.food: Chicken, broiler or fryers, breast, skinless, boneless, meat only, raw

steps: Whisk the oil, ginger, garlic, lime and honey in a salad bowl with salt and add the leaves and mint.
Split the chicken into thin fillets and grill about 5 minutes a side; rest 3 minutes and slice. Grill the pineapple too.
Toss in the chicken, pineapple and onion.

title: Waldorf Chicken Salad

lines.food: Chicken, broilers or fryers, breast, meat only, cooked, roasted

steps: Mix the chicken, celery, apple, raisins and walnuts with the mayonnaise, yogurt and lemon. Season.
Serve on the leaves with black pepper.

title: Roast Salmon Couscous Salad

lines.food: Tomatoes, red, ripe, raw, year round average

steps: Heat the oven to 400°F (200°C). Rub the salmon with 2 tsp oil, season, add half the lemon juice and roast 10 to 12 minutes.
Whisk the rest of the oil and lemon with the mustard, syrup, salt and pepper.
Build bowls of lettuce, couscous, onion, tomatoes and feta, add the salmon and drizzle with dressing.

title: Potato Zucchini Pancakes with Cottage Cheese

lines.food: Squash, summer, zucchini, includes skin, raw

steps: Mix the grated potato and zucchini with the egg, half the shallot, most of the dill, the flour, salt and pepper.
Fry small pancakes in a nonstick pan 3 minutes, flip and cook 1 more.
Mix the cottage cheese, yogurt, radish, the rest of the shallot and dill and spoon over.

title: Miso Salmon with Zucchini Noodle Salad

lines.food: Squash, summer, zucchini, includes skin, raw

steps: Mix the miso, 2 tbsp honey, ¼ cup soy, most of the ginger, the vinegar and 1 tbsp sesame oil; coat the salmon and chill 20 minutes.
Toss the zucchini noodles and radish with the rest of the sesame oil, ginger, honey and soy and the lime juice; chill.
Bake the salmon at 350°F (180°C) 12 minutes, then broil 2 to 3 minutes. Serve with the salad and sesame seeds.

title: Moroccan Spiced Cod with Bulgur Salad

lines.food: Tomatoes, red, ripe, raw, year round average

steps: Rub the cod with lemon, salt, pepper, garlic, the spices (and saffron if you have it) and 1 tbsp oil; rest a few minutes.
Cook the bulgur in salted water about 15 minutes. Mix the tomato, onion, olives and parsley.
Fry the cod 3 to 4 minutes a side, then warm the bulgur in the pan juices.
Serve the bulgur and cod topped with the tomato salad and lemon wedges.

title: Turkey Broccoli Noodle Stir-Fry

lines.food: Turkey, broiler, breast, meat only, raw
Onions, spring or scallions (includes tops and bulb), raw

steps: Cook the noodles, rinse cold and set aside.
Fry the turkey in the oil 3 to 4 minutes, add the broccoli 1 to 2 minutes, then ½ cup water and 3 tbsp soy sauce and cook until tender.
Mix the rest of the soy with the sesame oil, vinegar and ginger.
Toss in the noodles for 2 to 3 minutes, take off the heat, add the sauce and top with green onion and cilantro.

title: Tamari Baked Salmon with Zoodles and Quinoa

lines.food: Squash, summer, zucchini, includes skin, raw
Tomatoes, sun-dried, packed in oil, drained

steps: Marinate the salmon in the tamari, half the oil, paprika, vinegar, honey and sesame (up to an hour).
Soften the garlic in the rest of the oil, add the zucchini noodles 3 to 4 minutes and stir in the sun-dried tomatoes.
Bake the salmon at 480°F (250°C) about 7 minutes and stir its juices into the quinoa.
Serve the quinoa and zoodles topped with salmon and chili flakes.

title: Chinese Pork and Pineapple Stir-Fry

lines.food: Beef, tenderloin, steak, separable lean only, trimmed to 1/8" fat, all grades, raw
Rice, white, long-grain, regular, raw, enriched
Onions, spring or scallions (includes tops and bulb), raw

steps: Season the pork and coat it in the starch. Cook the rice. Mix the pineapple juice, soy sauce and vinegar.
Stir-fry the pepper, onion, garlic, chili and ginger in 1 tbsp oil over high heat 3 minutes and set aside.
Stir-fry the pork in the rest of the oil 3 minutes.
Return the vegetables with the pineapple and sauce and cook 2 minutes until glossy. Top with green onion and serve with rice.

title: Slow Cooker Chicken Fajitas

lines.food: Chicken, broiler or fryers, breast, skinless, boneless, meat only, raw
Tomatoes, red, ripe, canned, packed in tomato juice

steps: Layer half the peppers and onion in the slow cooker, add the chicken and coat with the honey, oil, lime, spices and tomatoes, then the rest of the vegetables.
Cook on high 3 to 4 hours.
Shred the chicken, stir it back in and cook 10 minutes on low. Serve in tortillas or over rice.

title: Creamy Chicken Mushroom Sun-Dried Tomato Pasta

lines.food: Chicken, broiler or fryers, breast, skinless, boneless, meat only, raw
Wheat flour, white, all-purpose, enriched, bleached
Tomatoes, sun-dried, packed in oil, drained
Cream, fluid, light (coffee cream or table cream)

steps: Cook the pasta.
Season the chicken, dust with flour and cook in the oil with the oregano; set aside.
Soften the onion and garlic, then the mushrooms 5 to 7 minutes, then the sun-dried tomatoes.
Return the chicken, add the cream and spinach and boil until wilted. Season and stir in the pasta.

title: Cajun Beef and Vegetable Rice

lines.food: Onions, spring or scallions (includes tops and bulb), raw
Beef, ground, 95% lean meat / 5% fat, raw
Tomato products, canned, paste, without salt added
Rice, white, long-grain, regular, enriched, cooked

steps: Cook the carrots, peppers and onion whites in the oil 10 minutes until softening.
Add the beef, season and brown about 10 minutes.
Stir in the Cajun seasoning and tomato paste, then the rice and 4 tbsp water, and cook 3 to 4 minutes. Top with the onion greens.

title: Garlic Ginger Shrimp and Vegetable Rice

lines.food: Rice, white, long-grain, regular, raw, enriched
Squash, summer, zucchini, includes skin, raw

steps: Cook the rice.
Stir-fry the carrot, pepper, onion and garlic in 1 tbsp oil 3 minutes, then the zucchini, ginger and chili flakes about 5.
Push aside and cook the shrimp in the rest of the oil on high until pink.
Mix the soy sauce, starch, ⅔ cup water and sugar, pour in and simmer 1 minute. Serve with rice.

title: Lemon Mint Turkey Meatballs with Couscous Salad
steps: Soften the onion in 1 tbsp oil 5 minutes, add chili flakes and garlic for a minute, then cool.
Mix with the turkey, half the mint, half the lemon zest, 1 tbsp dry couscous, salt and pepper; shape into balls and chill 15 minutes.
Pour hot stock over the couscous with the rest of the zest, cover 15 minutes, then fluff with half the lemon juice, blanched peas and radish.
Mix the yogurt with a little garlic, the rest of the mint and lemon. Fry the meatballs in the rest of the oil about 10 minutes, then cover a few minutes to cook through.

title: Honey Lime Salmon with Pineapple Rice

lines.food: Rice, white, long-grain, regular, raw, enriched
Corn, sweet, yellow, canned, whole kernel, drained solids

steps: Mix 3 tbsp honey with the lime juice, soy sauce, oil, ginger and garlic and marinate the skinless salmon about an hour.
Cook the rice and spread it out to cool. Mix with the corn, pineapple, cucumber, lime juice, the rest of the honey and the cilantro.
Bake the salmon at 410°F (210°C) about 18 minutes and serve with the rice.

title: Tomato Ginger Chicken Curry with Saffron Rice

lines.food: Chicken, broilers or fryers, dark meat, thigh, meat only, raw
Tomatoes, red, ripe, raw, year round average
Rice, white, long-grain, regular, raw, enriched

steps: Brown the seasoned thighs in the oil and set aside.
Soften the onion, garlic and ginger 3 to 4 minutes, add the turmeric and pepper, then the tomatoes and ¼ cup water; bring to a boil.
Return the chicken, cover and simmer 30 to 45 minutes until tender.
Steep a pinch of saffron in ¼ cup boiling water 5 minutes, then simmer with the rice, coconut oil, onion powder, salt and stock, covered, 15 minutes; rest 10.

title: One-Pot Turkey Chili Rice

lines.food: Rice, white, long-grain, regular, raw, enriched
Tomatoes, red, ripe, canned, packed in tomato juice
Beans, kidney, red, mature seeds, canned, drained solids
Corn, sweet, yellow, canned, whole kernel, drained solids

steps: Soften the onion and garlic in the oil 3 to 4 minutes, then brown the turkey 5 to 6 minutes.
Stir in the spices and raw rice, then the pepper, beans, corn, tomatoes and broth. Bring to a boil.
Cover and simmer on low 17 to 20 minutes. Add the cheese, cover 2 minutes to melt.

title: Baked Salmon with Rice and Tomatoes

lines.food: Rice, white, long-grain, regular, raw, enriched
Tomatoes, red, ripe, raw, year round average

steps: Cut the salmon into 4 and coat with the spices, honey, soy sauce, oil and 2 tbsp lemon juice.
Heat the oven to 400°F (200°C). Cook the rice and spread it in a baking dish.
Lay the salmon on top with the tomatoes, basil and lemon slices, pour over the marinade and bake 15 minutes. Serve with yogurt.

title: Mexican Chicken Fried Rice

lines.food: Chicken, broiler or fryers, breast, skinless, boneless, meat only, raw
Rice, white, long-grain, regular, raw, enriched
Corn, sweet, yellow, canned, whole kernel, drained solids
Beans, kidney, red, mature seeds, canned, drained solids
Tomatoes, red, ripe, raw, year round average

steps: Season the chicken with the spices, garlic, salt and pepper. Cook the rice and let it cool.
Fry the chicken in the oil 3 to 4 minutes, add the onion and pepper for 3 to 4 more.
Stir in the corn, beans and rice for 2 minutes, then the tomato off the heat.
Top with avocado, lime, chili and cilantro.

title: Soy Beef and Green Bean Pasta

lines.food: Beef, loin, top sirloin steak, boneless, lean, raw
Onions, spring or scallions (includes tops and bulb), raw

steps: Cook the pasta.
Sear the beef in the oil about 3 minutes and drizzle with the soy sauce.
Cook the garlic and onion pieces 3 minutes, return the beef with the stock and beans for 2 to 3 minutes, then toss in the pasta for 2.

title: Chicken Mango Stir-Fry

lines.food: Chicken, broiler or fryers, breast, skinless, boneless, meat only, raw

steps: Season the chicken and toss in the flour. Mix the vinegar, 3 tbsp water, soy sauce and honey.
Stir-fry the pepper, onion, chili, garlic and ginger in 1 tbsp oil 3 minutes and set aside.
Stir-fry the chicken in the rest of the oil 3 minutes.
Add back the vegetables, the mango and the sauce and cook 2 minutes until thick. Serve with rice.

title: Teriyaki Salmon with Green Bean Corn Rice

lines.food: Corn, sweet, yellow, canned, whole kernel, drained solids

steps: Mix the soy sauce, syrup, lime, ginger and garlic and marinate the skinless salmon 1 hour.
Cook the rice, adding the beans for the last 4 minutes, then stir in the corn.
Bake the salmon at 450°F (230°C) 8 to 10 minutes, scattering the sesame seeds on near the end.
Reduce the marinade in a pan until thick, stir in the sesame oil and drizzle over.

title: Orange Chicken Stir-Fry with Brown Rice

lines.food: Chicken, broiler or fryers, breast, skinless, boneless, meat only, raw
Onions, spring or scallions (includes tops and bulb), raw

steps: Whisk the orange juice, marmalade, soy sauce, sriracha and flour (thin with water if needed).
Cook the chicken in the oil 4 to 5 minutes and set aside.
Lower the heat, cook the garlic and onion a minute, then the snow peas and pepper 3 to 4 minutes. Add the rice.
Return the chicken with the carrot and sauce, stir until glossy and top with sesame and orange zest.

title: Pesto Pasta with Tuna and Almonds

lines.t: 240 g canned tuna in water, drained
lines.food: Fish, tuna, light, canned in water, drained solids

steps: Cook the pasta. Boil the beans about 5 minutes and drain.
Toss the pasta with the pesto and beans, top with the tuna and almonds and season.

title: Pepper Steak Stir-Fry

lines.t: 340 g eye of round steak, thinly sliced
lines.food: Beef, round, eye of round roast, boneless, separable lean only, trimmed to 0" fat, select, raw

steps: Toss the beef with 4 tsp soy sauce, the rice wine, 1 tsp flour and pepper.
Mix the rest of the soy sauce with 1 tbsp water and 2 tsp flour.
Sear the beef in 1 tsp oil until browned, about 2 minutes, and set aside.
Cook the onion and pepper in the rest of the oil 4 to 5 minutes, return the beef and sauce and toss until glossy. Keeps 4 days.

title: Bacon-Wrapped Beef Meatballs

lines.food: Beef, ground, 90% lean meat / 10% fat, raw
Pork, cured, bacon, pre-sliced, cooked, pan-fried

steps: Heat the oven to 400°F (200°C).
Mix everything except the bacon with salt and pepper and shape 12 meatballs.
Wrap each in bacon and bake 20 minutes, broiling the last 4 to 5 for crisp bacon.

title: Quick Beef Chow Mein

lines.food: Beef, tenderloin, steak, separable lean only, trimmed to 1/8" fat, all grades, raw
Onions, spring or scallions (includes tops and bulb), raw

steps: Cook the noodles.
Fry the garlic and ginger in the sesame oil a minute, add the beef for 2, then the leek, pepper and mushrooms for a few more.
Toss in the noodles with white pepper, a pinch of sugar, the soy sauce and 2 tbsp water for 2 minutes. Top with green onion.

title: Beef Chili with Sweet Potato Fries

lines.food: Beef, ground, 90% lean meat / 10% fat, raw
Tomatoes, red, ripe, canned, packed in tomato juice

steps: Heat the oven to 420°F (215°C). Toss the fries with the garlic and onion powder, salt, pepper, flour and oil, spread out and bake about 40 minutes, turning halfway.
Brown the beef 2 to 3 minutes with the chili flakes, add the tomatoes and 170 ml water and simmer uncovered 20 minutes.
Serve the chili over the fries with avocado and cilantro.

title: Cherry Yogurt Sorbet

lines.food: Plant-based yogurt alternative, made from soya, unsweetened

steps: Blend the frozen cherries with the honey, lemon juice, yogurt and 4 tbsp water until smooth.
Freeze 1 hour, then scoop. Garnish with mint.

title: Mango and Strawberry Quark Protein Bowls

lines.food: Skyr Icelandic style strained yogurt < 10 % fat in dry matter
Nuts, coconut meat, dried (desiccated), not sweetened

steps: Spoon the quark into bowls.
Top half with mango and granola and half with strawberries, banana and coconut.

title: Matcha Protein Chia Pudding

lines.food: Beverages, almond milk, unsweetened, shelf stable

steps: Stir the chia into the milk and chill; stir again after an hour and leave overnight.
In the morning, mix in the syrup, protein powder and matcha. Serve with berries.

title: Raspberry Almond Protein Smoothie

lines.food: Beverages, almond milk, unsweetened, shelf stable
Nuts, almond butter, plain, without salt added

steps: Blend everything with a handful of ice until smooth.

title: Green Glow Protein Smoothie

lines.food: Nuts, almond butter, plain, without salt added

steps: Blend everything until smooth and drink right away.

title: Vanilla Coffee Protein Shake

lines.food: Beverages, almond milk, unsweetened, shelf stable

steps: Blend everything with a handful of ice until smooth and serve cold.

title: Blueberry Cinnamon Protein Smoothie

lines.food: Beverages, almond milk, unsweetened, shelf stable

steps: Blend everything until smooth.

title: Cinnamon Roll Protein Smoothie

lines.food: Beverages, almond milk, unsweetened, shelf stable

steps: Blend everything with a cup of ice until smooth.

title: Raspberry Quark Protein Roulade
source: High Protein Recipe Book (Greg Smith, The Body Smith)

lines.food: Skyr Icelandic style strained yogurt < 10 % fat in dry matter

steps: Heat the oven to 350°F (180°C). Separate the eggs. Mix the yolks with half the quark, half the sweetener and the vanilla.
Whisk the whites to stiff peaks and gently fold in.
Spread thin on a greased or lined tray and bake 10 to 12 minutes until just firm; cool.
Mix the rest of the quark and sweetener, spread over the sheet, add raspberries and roll up.

title: Ginger Honey Peach Yogurt Bowl
source: High Protein Recipe Book (Greg Smith, The Body Smith)
steps: Stir the ginger and honey into the yogurt.
Top with the peach and flaxseeds.

title: Chocolate Coconut Protein Smoothie Bowl
source: High Protein Recipe Book (Greg Smith, The Body Smith)

lines.food: Skyr Icelandic style strained yogurt < 10 % fat in dry matter
Beverages, almond milk, unsweetened, shelf stable
Nuts, coconut meat, dried (desiccated), not sweetened

steps: Blend the banana, skyr, milk and protein until thick and smooth.
Pour into a bowl and top with cacao nibs and coconut.

title: Tuna and Soft Egg Toasts
source: High Protein Recipe Book (Greg Smith, The Body Smith)

lines.food: Fish, tuna, light, canned in water, drained solids

steps: Boil the eggs 6 minutes, cool and peel. Toast the bread.
Warm the tuna with the crème fraîche, hot sauce, mustard and seasoning 2 minutes, then add the lemon and parsley.
Pile onto the toast and top with the halved eggs.

title: Raspberry Coconut Yogurt Parfait
source: High Protein Recipe Book (Greg Smith, The Body Smith)

lines.food: Nuts, coconut meat, dried (desiccated), not sweetened

steps: Mix the yogurt with half the sweetener and the vanilla.
Blend the raspberries with the rest of the sweetener.
Layer yogurt, raspberry purée and coconut twice in tall glasses.

title: Spiced Lentil Tomato Kale Soup
source: High Protein Recipe Book (Greg Smith, The Body Smith)

lines.food: Tomatoes, red, ripe, canned, packed in tomato juice

steps: Soften the onion and garlic in the oil 4 to 5 minutes, then the celery a few more.
Stir in a bay leaf and the spices, then the tomatoes with their juice, the broth and lentils.
Simmer about 20 minutes until the lentils are soft, then stir in the kale until wilted. Season.

title: Pork Tenderloin with Creamy Garlic Spinach
source: High Protein Recipe Book (Greg Smith, The Body Smith)

lines.t: 500 g pork tenderloin, sliced into steaks
lines.food: Beef, tenderloin, steak, separable lean only, trimmed to 1/8" fat, all grades, raw
Wheat flour, white, all-purpose, enriched, bleached
Milk, lowfat, fluid, 1% milkfat, with added vitamin A and vitamin D

steps: Season the pork steaks.
Cook the garlic in half the oil 1 to 2 minutes, wilt the spinach and set aside.
Sear the pork in the rest of the oil until cooked through and set aside.
Stir the flour into the pan, whisk in the milk until thick, then stir in the yogurt and spinach and spoon over the pork.

title: Smoky Shrimp Fajitas
source: High Protein Recipe Book (Greg Smith, The Body Smith)
steps: Char the peppers and onion in the oil over high heat until tender; season and set aside.
Toss the shrimp in the mixed spices and cook 2 to 3 minutes until pink.
Return the vegetables, add cilantro and serve with lime and tortillas.

title: Steamed Turkey Cabbage Dumplings
source: High Protein Recipe Book (Greg Smith, The Body Smith)

lines.food: Onions, spring or scallions (includes tops and bulb), raw

steps: Mix the turkey, onions, garlic, ginger and 1 tbsp tamari and chill.
Blanch the whole cabbage in boiling water, peeling off leaves as they soften, and cool them in iced water.
Put a spoon of filling on each leaf, roll up tightly and steam about 15 minutes until cooked through.
Serve with the tamari mixed with the vinegar.

title: Mozzarella Spinach Chaffle Wrap
source: High Protein Recipe Book (Greg Smith, The Body Smith)

lines.food: Tomatoes, sun-dried, packed in oil, drained

steps: Mix the mozzarella, egg, chopped spinach, tomatoes and black pepper.
Spread thin in a buttered nonstick pan over medium heat and cook about 4 minutes until bubbling and golden, then flip briefly.
Fill like a wrap and fold.

title: Seared Scallops and Prawns with Radicchio
source: High Protein Recipe Book (Greg Smith, The Body Smith)

lines.food: Mollusks, scallop, (bay and sea), cooked, steamed

steps: Arrange the radicchio and arugula on a platter.
Shake the vinegar, oil, honey, salt and pepper in a jar.
Sear the scallops on an oiled very hot grill pan about 1 minute a side and warm the prawns.
Pile on the leaves and drizzle with dressing.

title: Ham, Broccoli and Pesto Penne
source: High Protein Recipe Book (Greg Smith, The Body Smith)

lines.food: Cream, fluid, light (coffee cream or table cream)

steps: Boil the pasta 12 minutes, adding the broccoli for the last 5 to 6.
Brown the ham in a nonstick pan.
Stir in the cream, yogurt and pesto off the heat, then toss with the drained pasta and broccoli.

title: Rosemary Balsamic Lamb Steaks with Broccolini
source: High Protein Recipe Book (Greg Smith, The Body Smith)

lines.food: Lamb, New Zealand, imported, leg chop/steak, bone-in, separable lean only, raw

steps: Make small cuts in the steaks, push in rosemary and drizzle with balsamic; rest 30 minutes.
Steam the broccolini with 3 to 4 tbsp water, covered, 4 to 5 minutes.
Grill or pan-fry the lamb 3 to 4 minutes a side, rest and serve with the broccolini.

title: Hoisin Chicken and Rice Traybake
source: High Protein Recipe Book (Greg Smith, The Body Smith)

lines.food: Rice, white, long-grain, regular, raw, enriched
Chicken, broiler or fryers, breast, skinless, boneless, meat only, raw

steps: Heat the oven to 400°F (200°C). Mix the hoisin, soy sauce and garlic.
Toss the chicken and onion with the oil and half the sauce in a roasting dish and roast 15 minutes.
Cook the rice. Add the broccoli and the rest of the sauce to the tray and roast 10 more minutes. Serve with the rice.

title: Chicken Asparagus Bake with Herb Buttermilk
source: High Protein Recipe Book (Greg Smith, The Body Smith)

lines.food: Chicken, broilers or fryers, dark meat, thigh, meat only, raw

steps: Heat the oven to 400°F (200°C). Roast the chicken with the oil 25 minutes.
Toss in the asparagus and roast 5 more.
Mix the buttermilk with the chives, garlic, salt and pepper, pour over and return 5 minutes to warm through.

title: Parmesan Baked Cod with Garlic Lemon Sauce
source: High Protein Recipe Book (Greg Smith, The Body Smith)
steps: Heat the oven to 400°F (200°C). Pat the cod dry and salt it.
Melt the butter in an ovenproof pan, cook the garlic briefly, then add the wine and lemon and simmer a minute.
Set the cod in the sauce, top with the Parmesan, paprika and parsley and bake 12 to 15 minutes until it flakes.

title: Turkey Roll with Goat Cheese and Cranberries
source: High Protein Recipe Book (Greg Smith, The Body Smith)

lines.food: Turkey, broiler, breast, meat only, raw
Soup, bouillon cubes and granules, low sodium, dry

steps: Heat the oven to 400°F (200°C). Wilt the spinach in the oil.
Pound the turkey to about 1 cm thick between parchment, spread with the spinach and goat cheese, roll and tie.
Roast about 30 minutes until cooked through.
Simmer the cranberries with the orange juice, honey and crumbled stock cube until thick and serve with the sliced turkey.

title: Thai Beef Salad
source: High Protein Recipe Book (Greg Smith, The Body Smith)

lines.food: Beef, loin, top sirloin steak, boneless, lean, raw

steps: Mix the oil, tamari, chili, salt and pepper and marinate the beef 10 minutes.
Toss the pepper, cucumber and carrot with lime juice and herbs.
Sear the beef on a hot grill pan 3 to 4 minutes a side, rest, slice thinly and lay over the salad.

title: Pesto Stuffed Chicken with Sweet Potato Mash
source: High Protein Recipe Book (Greg Smith, The Body Smith)

lines.food: Squash, summer, zucchini, includes skin, raw
Cream, fluid, light (coffee cream or table cream)
Chicken, broilers or fryers, dark meat, thigh, meat only, raw

steps: Heat the oven to 425°F (220°C). Put the zucchini, onion and sliced garlic on a tray.
Mix the cream cheese and pesto, stuff into the opened thighs, lay them on the vegetables, drizzle with oil and roast 25 to 30 minutes.
Boil the sweet potato until soft and mash with the crushed garlic and a spoon of cream cheese.

title: Chicken Parmesan with Salsa
source: High Protein Recipe Book (Greg Smith, The Body Smith)

lines.food: Chicken, broiler or fryers, breast, skinless, boneless, meat only, raw

steps: Heat the oven to 400°F (200°C). Pound the chicken to 5 mm and cut into 4.
Mix the breadcrumbs and Parmesan; dip the chicken in egg then the crumbs.
Brown in the butter and oil 2 minutes a side, put in a dish, spoon over the salsa, top with mozzarella and bake 15 minutes.

title: Lemon Yogurt Chicken with Carrot Beet Slaw
source: High Protein Recipe Book (Greg Smith, The Body Smith)

lines.food: Chicken, broiler or fryers, breast, skinless, boneless, meat only, raw
Seeds, pumpkin and squash seed kernels, dried
Seeds, sesame butter, tahini, from roasted and toasted kernels (most common type)

steps: Mix the yogurt, lemon zest, half the garlic and the cumin, coat the chicken and marinate 20 minutes.
Whisk the lemon juice, tahini, the rest of the garlic and 1 tbsp warm water.
Grill the chicken until cooked. Toss the carrot and beet with the tahini dressing and top with pumpkin seeds.

title: Oven-Baked Black Bean Beef Chili
source: High Protein Recipe Book (Greg Smith, The Body Smith)

lines.food: Beef, ground, 95% lean meat / 5% fat, raw
Tomato products, canned, paste, without salt added
Beans, black, mature seeds, canned, low sodium
Soup, bouillon cubes and granules, low sodium, dry
Tomatoes, red, ripe, canned, packed in tomato juice

steps: Heat the oven to 400°F (200°C). Brown the beef and onion in the oil in an ovenproof pot, then the garlic and spices.
Stir in the tomato paste, beans, tomatoes and the stock cube dissolved in about 200 ml boiling water.
Cover and bake about 40 minutes until rich and thick.

title: Ginger Chicken Mince and Vegetable Bowl
source: High Protein Recipe Book (Greg Smith, The Body Smith)

lines.food: Onions, spring or scallions (includes tops and bulb), raw

steps: Mix 1 tbsp soy sauce with the cornstarch, stir into the chicken and marinate 10 minutes.
Stir-fry the onion whites, garlic and ginger in the oil, then the chicken until cooked through.
Add the carrots and cabbage and the rest of the soy sauce and toss until just tender. Top with the onion greens.

title: Chicken and New Potato Hash
source: High Protein Recipe Book (Greg Smith, The Body Smith)

lines.food: Chicken, broiler or fryers, breast, skinless, boneless, meat only, raw
Onions, spring or scallions (includes tops and bulb), raw

steps: Microwave the potatoes 8 minutes, then halve.
Fry the chicken in the oil 2 minutes, add the onion and snow peas 1 minute, then the potatoes and paprika until crisp.
Wilt in the spinach, make a hollow, crack in the egg and cover until set.

title: Slow-Cooked Beef and Butternut Squash Stew
source: High Protein Recipe Book (Greg Smith, The Body Smith)

lines.food: Beef, chuck for stew, separable lean and fat, select, raw
Tomato products, canned, paste, without salt added
Soup, bouillon cubes and granules, low sodium, dry

steps: Put everything except the squash in a slow cooker with a bay leaf and about 300 ml water and cook on low 6 hours.
Add the squash for the last 2 hours.
On the stove: brown the beef with the onion and garlic, add the rest with water and simmer covered about 2 hours, adding the squash for the last 40 minutes.

title: Chocolate Strawberry Protein Cakes
source: High Protein Recipe Book (Greg Smith, The Body Smith)

lines.food: Nuts, coconut meat, dried (desiccated), not sweetened
Beverages, almond milk, unsweetened, shelf stable

steps: Heat the oven to 350°F (180°C).
Mix the flour, protein, coconut, baking powder and salt, then the milk, syrup and vanilla. Fold in the strawberries.
Divide between 2 greased ramekins and bake about 20 minutes.

title: Warm Berries with Protein Yogurt
source: High Protein Recipe Book (Greg Smith, The Body Smith)
steps: Mix the protein into the yogurt.
Microwave the berries 1 to 2 minutes until soft and jammy and stir through (a sugar-free jelly pot is a nice extra).

title: Mango Strawberry Protein Popsicles
source: High Protein Recipe Book (Greg Smith, The Body Smith)
steps: Whisk the yogurt and protein smooth, stir in the fruit and granola.
Fill popsicle molds and freeze overnight.

title: Strawberry Protein Fluff
source: High Protein Recipe Book (Greg Smith, The Body Smith)

lines.food: Beverages, almond milk, unsweetened, shelf stable

steps: Blend the strawberries, milk, protein and stevia with a stick blender to a thick paste.
Whisk 3 to 5 minutes until it puffs up into a mousse. Top with grated chocolate.

title: Baked Pears with Spiced Honey Yogurt
source: High Protein Recipe Book (Greg Smith, The Body Smith)

lines.food: Cereals, oats, regular and quick, not fortified, dry

steps: Heat the oven to 400°F (200°C) and set the pears cut side up in a lined dish.
Mix the pecans, cranberries, oats, butter, 40 g honey, cinnamon and a pinch of salt and pile onto the pears.
Bake about 25 minutes until tender. Serve with the yogurt sweetened with the rest of the honey and a little cinnamon.

title: Mango Greek Yogurt Smoothie
source: Pre and Post Workout Meals Cookbook

lines.food: Milk, lowfat, fluid, 1% milkfat, with added vitamin A and vitamin D

steps: Blend everything with 1½ cups ice (less if the fruit is frozen) until smooth.

title: Chocolate Peanut Butter Power Smoothie
source: Pre and Post Workout Meals Cookbook

lines.food: Milk, lowfat, fluid, 1% milkfat, with added vitamin A and vitamin D
Peanut butter, smooth style, without salt

steps: Blend everything until smooth.

title: Strawberry Banana Yogurt Smoothie
source: Pre and Post Workout Meals Cookbook

lines.food: Milk, lowfat, fluid, 1% milkfat, with added vitamin A and vitamin D

steps: Blend everything with ½ cup ice until smooth. (Leave out the yogurt for a lighter pre-workout version.)

title: Piña Colada Recovery Smoothie
source: Pre and Post Workout Meals Cookbook

lines.food: Beverages, coconut milk, sweetened, fortified with calcium, vitamins A, B12, D2

steps: Blend until smooth. The yogurt (or a scoop of protein) makes it a post-workout drink.

title: Green Island Getaway Smoothie
source: Pre and Post Workout Meals Cookbook

lines.food: Milk, lowfat, fluid, 1% milkfat, with added vitamin A and vitamin D

steps: Blend everything until smooth (a frozen ripe banana makes it sweeter).

title: Cherry Chia Energy Bites
source: Pre and Post Workout Meals Cookbook

lines.food: Cereals, oats, regular and quick, not fortified, dry
Nuts, coconut meat, dried (desiccated), not sweetened
Peanut butter, smooth style, without salt

steps: Mix everything in a bowl.
Chill an hour (or freeze 15 minutes), then roll into 20 balls.

title: Lemon Blueberry Almond Bites
source: Pre and Post Workout Meals Cookbook

lines.food: Cereals, oats, regular and quick, not fortified, dry

steps: Blend the almonds, lemon juice and honey, add half the oats and blend smooth.
Stir in the rest of the oats, the chia and blueberries.
Chill an hour (or freeze 15 minutes) and roll into 24 balls.

title: Apple Cinnamon Oat Bites
source: Pre and Post Workout Meals Cookbook

lines.food: Cereals, oats, regular and quick, not fortified, dry
Peanut butter, smooth style, without salt

steps: Mix everything with a pinch of salt.
Chill an hour (or freeze 15 minutes) and roll into 16 balls.

title: Pumpkin Spice Energy Bites
source: Pre and Post Workout Meals Cookbook

lines.food: Cereals, oats, regular and quick, not fortified, dry
Peanut butter, smooth style, without salt
Seeds, pumpkin and squash seed kernels, dried

steps: Mix everything with a pinch of cloves and salt.
Chill an hour (or freeze 15 minutes) and roll into about 14 balls.

title: Peanut Butter Chocolate Trail Mix
source: Pre and Post Workout Meals Cookbook

lines.food: Sweets, confectioner's coating or chips, peanut butter

steps: Mix everything and store in a sealed jar. A serving is ¼ cup.

title: Spicy Savory Seed and Pretzel Mix
source: Pre and Post Workout Meals Cookbook

lines.food: Seeds, pumpkin and squash seed kernels, dried

steps: Toss everything together and store sealed. A serving is ½ cup.

title: Cereal Lover's Trail Mix
source: Pre and Post Workout Meals Cookbook

lines.food: Cereal, ready to eat, Shredded Wheat: spoon size, Post
Cereals ready-to-eat, GENERAL MILLS, Rice CHEX

steps: Mix everything and keep in a sealed jar. A serving is ¼ cup; good before a workout.

title: Turkey and Cream Cheese Spinach Wrap
source: Pre and Post Workout Meals Cookbook

lines.food: Tomatoes, red, ripe, raw, year round average

steps: Spread the tortilla with cream cheese (jalapeño cream cheese is great).
Add the turkey, cheese, tomatoes and spinach and roll up. Keeps 3 to 4 days.

title: BBQ Chicken Wrap with Yogurt Ranch
source: Pre and Post Workout Meals Cookbook

lines.food: Chicken, broilers or fryers, breast, meat only, cooked, roasted
Tomatoes, red, ripe, raw, year round average

steps: Mix the chicken with the barbecue sauce and spread on the tortilla.
Add the cheese, onion, tomatoes and lettuce, fold the ends in and roll.
Stir the ranch seasoning into the yogurt for dipping.

title: Strawberry Peanut Butter Power Oatmeal
source: Pre and Post Workout Meals Cookbook

lines.food: Cereals, oats, regular and quick, not fortified, dry
Milk, lowfat, fluid, 1% milkfat, with added vitamin A and vitamin D
Peanut butter, smooth style, without salt

steps: Bring the oats, milk, ⅓ cup water, strawberries, honey, vanilla and a pinch of salt to a boil, then simmer 5 to 7 minutes until thick.
Stir in the yogurt to cool it and top with peanut butter.

title: Apple Slices with Peanut Butter Yogurt Dip
source: Pre and Post Workout Meals Cookbook

lines.food: Peanut butter, smooth style, without salt

steps: Mix the peanut butter and yogurt and dip the apple slices.

title: Cranberry Grape Chicken Salad
source: Pre and Post Workout Meals Cookbook

lines.food: Chicken, broilers or fryers, breast, meat only, cooked, roasted
Grapes, red or green (European type, such as Thompson seedless), raw

steps: Stir the yogurt and cranberry sauce together.
Fold in everything else. Eat in a sandwich or pita, with crackers or on its own.

title: Bagel Egg and Avocado Breakfast Sandwich
source: Pre and Post Workout Meals Cookbook

lines.food: Bagels, plain, enriched, with calcium propionate (includes onion, poppy, sesame)

steps: Split and toast the bagel and spread with cream cheese.
Fry or scramble the egg.
Fill with the egg, spinach and avocado.

title: Chicken Pico Quesadilla with Yogurt Ranch
source: Pre and Post Workout Meals Cookbook

lines.food: Chicken, broilers or fryers, breast, meat only, cooked, roasted

steps: Mix the chicken, cheese, pico and pepper and spread over half the tortilla; fold.
Brown in a pan over low-medium heat 1 to 2 minutes a side.
Serve with the yogurt mixed with ranch seasoning.

title: Peanut Butter Yogurt Banana Pops
source: Pre and Post Workout Meals Cookbook

lines.food: Peanut butter, smooth style, without salt

steps: Halve the bananas, push in sticks and freeze 30 minutes on parchment.
Dip in the yogurt and freeze about an hour until firm.
Drizzle with warmed peanut butter and freeze 30 minutes more. Keeps 3 months wrapped.

title: Citrus Chicken Pasta Salad
source: Pre and Post Workout Meals Cookbook

lines.food: Chicken, broilers or fryers, breast, meat only, cooked, roasted
Tomatoes, red, ripe, raw, year round average

steps: Cook the pasta, rinse cold and drain.
Toss with the spinach, tomatoes and chicken and scatter the almonds and feta.
Blend the juices, honey, mustard and salt, then blend in the oil. Dress only what you'll eat now.

title: Greek Yogurt Tuna Sandwich
source: Pre and Post Workout Meals Cookbook

lines.food: Fish, tuna, light, canned in water, drained solids

steps: Mix the tuna, yogurt, celery, carrot, relish and lemon pepper.
Toast the bread and fill.

title: Moroccan Beef with Apricot Couscous
source: An Athlete's Guide to Basic Food Prep and Cooking

lines.food: Beef, ground, 95% lean meat / 5% fat, raw

steps: Soften the onions in the oil 5 minutes, then brown the beef with the spices 6 to 8 minutes.
Add the apricots and stock and simmer 10 to 15 minutes until reduced.
Pour about 450 ml boiling water over the couscous, cover until fluffy, then fork in the lemon zest and mint.
Serve the beef over the couscous with the cashews.

title: Grilled Chicken with Zesty Rice Salad
source: An Athlete's Guide to Basic Food Prep and Cooking

lines.food: Rice, white, long-grain, regular, raw, enriched
Chicken, broiler or fryers, breast, skinless, boneless, meat only, raw

steps: Boil the rice 12 to 13 minutes, adding the beans and peas for the last 3. Rinse cold and drain.
Rub the chicken and pepper with 1 tbsp oil and griddle about 10 minutes, turning once, until cooked. Slice the chicken.
Whisk the rest of the oil with the mustard, 50 ml water, lemon juice and pepper.
Toss the rice with the peppers, spinach and dressing and top with the chicken and lemon zest.

title: Eat-a-Rainbow Feta Omelette
source: An Athlete's Guide to Basic Food Prep and Cooking

lines.food: Tomatoes, red, ripe, raw, year round average

steps: Whisk the eggs with salt, pepper and the feta. Heat the broiler.
Fry the onion in the oil until golden, add the pepper 2 minutes, the tomatoes a minute, then the spinach.
Pour in the eggs, stir to coat, cook a few minutes, then finish under the broiler (the handle gets hot).

title: Chicken, Lime and Cashew Stir-Fry
source: An Athlete's Guide to Basic Food Prep and Cooking

lines.food: Chicken, broiler or fryers, breast, skinless, boneless, meat only, raw
Mung beans, mature seeds, sprouted, raw

steps: Have everything ready; this is quick. Sear the chicken in the sesame oil in a very hot wok until coloured.
Add the ginger, garlic and chili for a minute, then the cashews, sprouts and kale for 1 to 2.
Add the lime, soy and fish sauce, reduce slightly and toss in the cilantro. Serve with rice and bok choy.

title: Light Fish Pie with Grated Potato Topping
source: An Athlete's Guide to Basic Food Prep and Cooking

lines.food: Milk, lowfat, fluid, 1% milkfat, with added vitamin A and vitamin D
Onions, spring or scallions (includes tops and bulb), raw

steps: Heat the oven to 350°F (180°C). Simmer the milk with the green onion and 2 bay leaves, stir in the cornstarch mixed with 3 tbsp water and simmer 3 to 4 minutes until slightly thick. Add the mustard and dill.
Remove the bay leaves, stir in the fish, shrimp and peas and pour into a 1.5-litre dish.
Blanch the whole potatoes 1 minute, grate, squeeze dry and toss with the oil, cheese and seasoning. Scatter over the fish.
Bake 30 minutes until bubbling and golden.

title: Banana Oat Muffins
source: An Athlete's Guide to Basic Food Prep and Cooking

lines.food: Milk, lowfat, fluid, 1% milkfat, with added vitamin A and vitamin D
Cereals, oats, regular and quick, not fortified, dry

steps: Heat the oven to 350°F (175°C) and grease a muffin tin.
Whisk the oil, honey, eggs, banana and milk, then the cinnamon, vanilla, baking soda and a pinch of salt.
Stir in the oats and flour, divide into 12, sprinkle with oats and bake about 25 minutes until a skewer comes out clean.

title: Chia Raspberry Banana Porridge
source: An Athlete's Guide to Basic Food Prep and Cooking
